I had been seeking a reasonably priced. fully synthetic area rug with an Oriental pattern for several months and had found some I liked, but later found the backing was typically jute, which is organic and needs special care. As a pet owner, I wanted something that looked good and was easy to clean; synthetic fibers are hard to stain. The backing on this rug is latex, which is washable and does not slip on the floor. I was also looking for a color scheme of blues, creams and muted greens and finally found it in the Blue Kartoum Rug. Best of all, it was on sale! I ordered a 5 x 8 area rug and a matching smaller one. When it arrived, I was somewhat dismayed that the brown was so prominent and the blue less so. In the photo, it appears to have a really wide blue border, but in the sizes I got, it is not as wide and the cream that edges the rug minimizes it more. As I liked the other features of the rug I decided to keep it for a few days and see if it grew on me-it did. Actually, the dark pattern is not all brown, but dark green with dark beige patterns intermixed. The blue band is more of a teal with green, off white and tan designs scattered throughout. Interestingly, there is also a paler, medium blue design interspersed on the off white background in the middle of the rug and that helps to balance the brown. It is really an interesting pattern and it will certain help to disguise any dirt. As for being easy care, one of my cats decided to christen it with its breakfast, I wiped it up and squirted some Res*lve type rug cleaner on it and pouf, it was gone! The rug can be washed in a washing machine if you have a smaller size or a professional sized washer. When mine needs it, I plan to drag it out on the deck, blast it with the hose and some soap, then hang it out to dry. Its not super thick so it should be easy to do. (The 5 x 8 weighs 15 lbs.) The weave is dense, and it is soft underfoot; the way the pattern blends smoothly together makes it looks like a much more expensive rug. However, if you want a super thick pile this will not be up to your standards, although you could get a pad to increase the thickness. All in all, I feel like this rug is quite a bargain! (I did omit one star because I wish there had been a bit more blue and less brown. What can I say, I love blue!)

I bought this spice rack based on the numerous positive reviews. However, I regretted this decision after I unboxed it at home. It includes stale-smelling spices of dubious quality; plus, one of the lids was only partly screwed into place so I ended up with a box of loose coriander. My biggest complaint, by far, is that the lids are very cheaply made, so when a bottle of a granular spice is used, a large amount gets trapped in the threads between the cap and the neck of the bottle. Then, the trapped spice pours out of this space when the bottle is replaced to the rack. I have had to clean up garlic granules off my counter and off the spice rack every single time Ive used it. Im not sure I want to go to the trouble of replacing the stock spices with my own if this happens with every container (which, from a cursory inspection, appears will be the case for anything granular). Switching to area rugs and hardwood from wall-to-wall carpeting means less vacuuming. Yay! But a light weight vacuum--which to choose? I went with the Dirt Devil Cyclonic Pet Bagless (another yay!) I have not owned this vacuum very long. It keeps clogging non-stop and shuts off. I should not have to unclog the hose EVERY time I use the vacuum. The store wont accept it back as it is past their return policy. Worst vacuum I have ever owned. The tools are a joke.

This thing works awesome. However, it does require maintenance. After every use I clean all the parts. It is very easy to take apart. If it doesnt suck up debris, either the hose is plugged, the exhaust filter and or foam is plugged, or the canister is full inside - that is assuming the motor is running. If the beater bar/brush doesnt turn and the motor is running - is the belt on? Did it fall off or break? I have read the bad reviews and I can explain it like this if I may: if you want a vac that doesnt require any maintenance, then buy a worthless bag vacuum and just change the bag. However, even those vacuums can plug in the hose or the bag can fill up. The reason the bag-less vacs work so well is, if you keep them clean - hoses clear, canister and filters clean and clear, they move as much air out as they pull in. Thats the key - AIR FLOW. Thats why bag vacs lose suction so soon, and these dont. Once the inside of the bag gets a thin layer of dust on it, the air flow drops dramatically and so does the suction. Also, if it runs and shuts off and you dont see any dirt movement inside the canister (thats part of why its clear), like the other person said, something is wrong. If the motor gets too hot, again, due to lack of air flow (air flow cools the motor as well as sucking up debris) and it has internal overload, which mos do, it will shut down until it cools off, then reset itself. Once it resets, it should start again. In closing, let me say this: if you are all thumbs and you dont know which end of the tool you are supposed to use when using tools (like my brother) dont buy one of these vacuums unless someone mechanical can help you take care of it. It is a simple, reliable effective machine. However, it does have one weakness: you have to TAKE CARE OF and MAINTAIN the dang thing!!! Thats all I have to say, thank-you.

This pillow is Visco-elastic memory foam which is filler to memory to keep it from sinking down. Real memory that has memory is polyurethane foam. I didnt know that at the time of ordering. I guess they added the filler because of customers complaining of memory pillows flattening down while sleeping; which is true for memory foam. Good ones are high density. Im 6 tall side sleeper and when I put my neck on the pillow pillow is fighting it back into unnatural position. I tried to push it back with my neck to keep it in natural position. Then it gives me neck pressure and headache. For 3 months me and my husband tried to sleep on this pillow and it ended on the floor every time. It is excellent for back support when watching TV. The pillow has no cooling feature. The cooling is on the upper side of pillowcase only. So you can take it off and put it on better feeling pillow. The pillow looks good and has no chemical smell. Now, if you have just the right distance of the neck versus head, this pillow just might be it for you. For us it didnt happen.

The first thing I noticed was that it smelled pretty bad - like commercial processing but the packaging warns you of this and after airing it out for 3-4 days it smells just fine now. The second thing I noticed was how wonderfully cool it felt - no need to flip it like the old ones. It is very challenging for me to find bras, as I am a big woman with a large chest, but I also have arthritis, which makes a back closure hard for me. All of the front closures I have gotten in the past have been too flimsy and have worn out quickly. Having a front closure underwire is a game changer! The support is really good, and its easy to put on. By the end of each day, Im certainly ready to have it off, but I rarely have to adjust it during the day, and the support is steady throughout the day; doesnt start to sag as the day progresses. And, compared with my Wacoal bras, with all of the sales and discounts that Penneys is offering, I got 7 bras for the price of 2 of my Wacoals. So, even if they do wear out a little faster, I havent broken my bank just to get a bra that fits well, wears well, and is easy for me to put on. Well done! The only thing I would recommend is getting one cup size larger than you normally wear, as I feel like they run just a little small in the cup size.

These bras arrived in a timely fashion. I read previous reviews prior to ordering for some help in my decision making. The were very nice quality and I loved the styling! Unfortunately, just as some of the reviews had stated, these bras DO run small! I took them back to the store and experienced a very smooth return process. I wish I knew what size to order for sure, but I dont. If I had to guess I would say at least a full cup size larger than you normally wear. The other part was snug as well so probably up 2 inches larger than what you normally wear.
Comfortable, wide straps, front closure. Need I say any more. Oh, and pretty!
pretty. great support. front closure to be kind to my rotator cuff!

I thought I could deal with a front-hook simply because I really wanted wide straps. This is a pretty bra. The wide straps are amazing. After wearing a couple of times, however, the underwires were agony.. Im a B cup, but I ordered a C, so all of the underarm spillover could be accommodated. Not a good construct. Two stars because of the pretty, though.

I have a shoulder injury and unable to fasten my bra in the back. I bought three of these bras in different colors. They work great. It took a little practice to fasten and unfasten but after a few times it is now a snap.
If there was another bra with the front attachment that fit this good and does not have the front stitching on the cup I would buy it. Everything stays in place all day. Underwire Bra 1245 44DD

Ive bought other bras from JCPenney, just not this brand. I prefer bras with front closures because theyre easier to put on. This one was not. I understand that there are no hooks so you cant adjust the band, but this was still way too tight. I got it on after some effort and pulling and squeezing but if I had a chance to try it on before buying, I wouldnt buy my size. Very pretty and wider than projected which is good

I really like this product.I have such a hard time with shaving.I cant seem to avoid getting razor burn and ingrown hairs, and it is nearly impossible for me to shave my legs hairless.Whuke these products didnt get rid of my problems completely,they (the products) lessened them until they were practically unnoticeable.The only way to improve this product would be to make it in a bigger size.
Cons: expensive, gelle burns if care isnt taken in bikini zone
Pros: everything else!

Love this product, but I did notice the last time I used it that the cooling gel stung quite a bit. Overall, the hair on my legs does seem to grow less quickly, and the shaving cream is worth buying on its own.
The pearl soufflé stuff isnt that great, but my boyfriend really likes the cool gel, makes skin nice and soft after shaving and helps prevent against ingrown and such

Wow. I bought this since Im always on the look out for something to shave my legs with. I say something because Ive used everything from shaving cream to straight coconut oil. I have very sensitive skin on my legs and very coarse and plentiful hair on them that grows back the next day.This makes for a negative experience every time I shave my legs. Shaving alone hurts since the hair gets tugged as I go and I usually break out in a rash somewhere on my legs right after Im done shaving and I get ingrowns really easily. This stuff is ok, the shave cream is the best part. The after shave doesnt really work, I guess its a good trial size the bottles are tiny

i love everything about it i wear every day from the time i receive it

Great value for the money and a perfect fit....I will be ordering more of these!
IF YOU ENJOY A CUP OF COFFEE WHILE WATCHING THE SNOW COMING DOWN YOU WILL APPRECIATE THIS PRODUCT, GREAT TO USE AS A LAYER TOO.

Not sure why so many people are having issues with this coffee maker. Mine functions within specs and makes a pot of coffee in 5 to 8 minutes depending on how much I make. Two, it has a balance problem on the right side corner just in front of the warmer. Its one wobbly coffee maker, but I solved this by putting the instruction manual under it, perfect for shimming! Three, sometimes the valve on the filter container doesnt close and coffee goes everywhere, then again, Ive never owned and brand of coffee maker that didnt do this from time to time. My BIGGEST issue is the pump. Maybe your engineers could put a 2 or even a 3 hp pump in the coffee maker so all the grounds are actually being used. Anything to increase the amount of water flow, too much coffee going to waste! Pump needs MORE power! Please put a better pump into your coffee makers!

The Brew Now button is the same button to turn the pot off, so after filling the pot with water and grounds like I do everyday. I go to push the button to brew and it turns off. It does not work or brew. The light only flashes. I saved the instruction book, none of the troubleshooting has worked. So now I have to find an authorized dealer to help with this. This pot was way too much money for all of these problems.

However, after rummaging around for the book, it says I need vinegar and will take 45 minutes! That is insane! I guess the extra time gives me the time I need to write this review from a disappointed customer.

We bought four of these for our guest rental cottages, and loved the idea, especially the hot water station - much quicker than heating water in a kettle on the stove. I tried flushing the water tank while upside down, but it seems the grounds have made their way deep into the heater.

For almost 3 years I have been trying on and searching for Chinos/Khakis that work for me. My friends say I am particular about my clothes.... But, why would I buy something that is almost what I want ? I would rather wait until i find exactly what I want/need.

I saw the Liz Claiborne chino shorts and pants in the store and loved their style and how soft the fabric feels. I bought a pair of shorts and a pair of the pants. Of course, I expected they would fit like all the other pants/shorts I try on.

I have a number of scars on my lower back and an implant in my hip area. They are sensitive to anything that might rub or put pressure on them. Most womens pants seem to have a snug fitting waist. If I buy pants that are comfortable at the waist, they are too big and baggy everywhere else. So, it is hard to find good quality, good fitting everyday pants. Thank you Liz Claiborne - these are PERFECT... The waist is cut to fit a real human body and the front fits my gut with no bulges or saggy crotch.

These are cropped style pants designed to be rolled up. However, I dont care for cropped or Capri pants. I was hoping to wear them unrolled. The regular length is 25 rolled-28 unrolled and a little too short to wear unrolled. Luckily, these are available online in tall with a 28 rolled and 31 unrolled inseam. The tall worked out to be the perfect length for me to be able to wear them as long pants.
In the meantime, a friend of mine saw them, loved them and tried them on.... she is tall and likes to wear Capri and ankle pants to work. Being tall, she can wear these rolled or unrolled.
So... today I am back to order more pants and shorts for myself and some pants for her.

I am especially happy to see that they are on sale today. The sale price is excellent for such nice quality pants. Even if these werent on sale, I would still be buying them. I am just glad I finally find such well fitting pair of pants and the same fitting and style in Bermuda shorts.

Sometimes when you find something you really love, you have to get them right away. I wanted to get them before the sizes I need are sold out. Also, you never know how long these will be available from Liz Claiborne at JCP.
The style of these pants can be dressed up with a blouse or sweater for a dinner out. They also work nicely with a t-shirt or polo for just bumming around town.

The fabric is a nice mid-weight and very soft. They will definitely be able to wear them all year. They wash up well and did not shrink. They are cotton with some spandex which make them comfortable but dont stretch out of shape like other brands I have owned.

For anyone that has to wear khaki pants/shorts to work, these are really very comfortable with some stretch for ease of movement. The fabric seems durable and I think they will last me quite sometime.

The only downside - I wish the pockets were a little deeper. The front pockets are a little deeper than most womens pants these days. However, the back pockets are not very deep at all. For example, you would not be able to put a phone in the back pocket.
These days it seems like all womens pants have really small pockets. I hate when they are so shallow that any pocket change or keys fall out when you sit.
As, I said, I came back today to order additional pairs of the shorts and pants. I wasnt planning to write a review. Especially such a long one.

Fortunately, it is for a product I like and not something I did not like.Even if I dont win... I win with these pants !!!

The refrigerator shelves are short and set back in comparison to our old unit. The door shelves are so deep that bottles easily tip forward unless you have the shelves full. The two short hydrator drawers offer far less useful space than the single large drawer. Reaching everything requires more stooping and bending over than our old unit whose shelves started farther off the floor because of the mechanism below. Also, the spacing between the shelf wires is so wide that bottles, pop cans and other things easily tip over when moved. If we could have replaced the leaky door gaskets on our old unit, we would have kept it for another 36 years. I fell in love with these boots. So much so I went back and bought them in both colors. I have always had larger, more muscular calves having been a competitive skater in my younger days and then having had babies and putting babies and well we all know how that goes. Needless to say many moons later and boots were not my friends. As much as I wanted to wear the cute styles I just could not. However I never gave up the dream. each fall I would try on boot and get frustrated until I gave up and walked away. This year though it was different. I found these wonders. I tried them on. They fit. They fit like a dream. They even have room to spare!!! They are comfy. I can walk for hours in them. The width is perfect. They fit perfectly from the ankles on up with jeans and leggings. The color is great in both the cognac and black. They look like real leather. I get lots of compliments on them. The double elastic along the back allows just the right amount of stretch at the calf. Finally...a wide calf boot that my wide calf can fit into!!

I bought these in store a day ago. I tried them on and they felt pretty good, just a little stiff...but I thought after wearing them for a few days theyd lose the stiff factor. What I was feeling wasnt stiffness, it was tightness. I put them on for a few minutes when I got home and after about 5 minutes my feet were throbbing from how tight the boots were. They are way too narrow. I bought an 11, the biggest they go, and length wise theyre perfect and they fit perfectly around my calves and look fantastic! So other than the extreme narrowness, they are great boots. If you have super narrow feet, theyd probably be perfect for you!
As someone whos not had to purchase wide-width in the past, I thought maybe my feet were swollen. Definitely not the case.

These are wonderful. Theyre cozy cotton sweaters in pleasant colors, and they last. I bought about six last winter and wore them almost constantly all season, to find that when I tried one on today it still fits perfectly and is snuggly-warm.

Also, the color stays. I cant guarantee they wont bleed on other clothes a little the first time you wash them (I dont remember), but they stay really vibrant even after a season of wear, which probably means the color is going nowhere in the seasons to come too.

A few tips:1) Go into the store to try one on. The first one I tried on was a size too small--both physically uncomfortable and a one-way ticket to self-consciousness--but one size up and it was cute and comfortable. It was as if Id picked up an entirely different brand. If youre going to buy these, at the very least get some recent and accurate measurements and compare them to the chart.
XL fits perfectly on me; Im 55 and bust-waist-hips is 45-39-48, and you can see how long the sweater comes to my hips in my picture. Hope this helps my fellow curvy girls!

2) You can wash them along with other clothes--they arent picky there--but youll want to dry them by hanging or laying them flat most of the time. Occasionally run them through the dryer if the fit starts feeling odd (which can happen if you hang them to dry, as they start to stretch lengthwise).

Its best if, when you use the dryer, you hang around when its about to finish and put your sweater on as soon as you can after it comes out... not because itll dry better or anything, but because its really warm and it feels absolutely luxurious. :)

The basket miss-aligns and falls off track if you do not really pay attention to how you push the rack back into the unit. When this happens, all the dishes crash together causing an opportunity for damage. It is also very difficult to get the rack back on track if the rack (cart) falls while fully loaded with dishes. Secondly; this unit never fully rinses well. Many times I end up hand washing the dishes. I have tried most all detergents and rinse products on the market. I am also the queen of rinsing dishes before putting them in the dishwasher, they are basically clean when they go in so why my dishes come out dirty is beyond me. Occasionally I will get a clean glass, but the recommended detergent leaves little granulates all over the dishes too, so I still have to rinse them before use. The top rack sometimes gives way and falls to the lower height when there isnt even a lot of cups loaded, scaring the life out of me since all the dishes clang together when it happens. The bottom adjustable prongs give way and dont hold up. Ill be better off just hand washing everything and using it as a drying rack, but even then I would have to worry about the top rack falling down an potentially breaking my glasses. It is quiet, probably the only good thing about it, well and it makes my kitchen look pretty... But other than that I am very unsatisfied and will buy a different brand in the future.

While searching for replacement parts, I found numerous reviews for issues with the water inlet valve failing on this model. Sure enough, after about 2.5 years, the valve failed , which would have caused serious flooding damage if I hadnt been standing right next to it at the time. As it was, there was a decent amount of water able to spread across the floor, under cabinets, and even into the basement below in the time it took me to access the shutoff under the sink. When I took the front access panel off, it didnt take long to figure out what the problem was, the valve was physically broken in two pieces, with the part attached to the wiring sitting on the floor. I didnt hook up the water line for the automatic ice-maker in the refrigerator (also an LG) for this reason, probably a good thing I didnt.

I had to replace an old dishwasher that leaked from the motor area and ruined my kitchen floor. After replacing the floor with new ceramic tile, I went looking for a replacement washer. An astute sales person pointed out a very important fact. Some dishwashers have vents through the top or the sides of their doors. These models would eventually damage the counter top (I dont have granite, unfortunately) or the wooden cabinets on either side by venting steam into the wood. The LG vents through the bottom, which is now the safest place since I have waterproofed the floor. Only one other make of dishwasher (a much more expensive machine) had venting from the bottom of the door. I was happy that the LG had the features I wanted at a reasonable price. Now that the machine is installed, I am amazed at how much better it cleans as compared to my old machine. Eggs for breakfast and crusty casserole dishes are no problem! Plus its quiet and the stainless steel tub looks much cleaner than the plastic models. Thanks, LG!

My wife and I loved this bed - and the matching end tables. But we had to return it. For a platform bed, the slats were far too weak and flexible to support a bed - particularly if you are expecting to use this bed for a queen or, as in our case, a king bed. The cross slats were so weak and flexible that it made a great, new mattress feel like horrible. First, only 3 of the slots have any kind of support across the throw - in the form of two dowels that went to the floor. The rest are just soft wood that cant handle any amount of weight without bending. We didnt even realize we had an issue till we went to another bedding store and looked at what other platform beds have for slats - firm, resilient - the complete opposite of this bed.
We so wanted to keep this bed - but the slats were literally ruining a brand new mattress. Such a shame!

I was a little nervous about ordering this bed considering the other two reviews, but decided to take a chance. Im glad I did. The bed has a sleek, modern design with a rich dark finish. The finish is seamless. The slats were sturdier than the slats on my old platform bed and there are double legs down the center; top, middle and bottom. We ordered a Serta iSeries king size mattress at the same time. It is a heavy mattress and there has been no sagging or any other issues with the slats. The bed, mattress and two dressers [fully assembled were delivered a day early and the two gentlemen who delivered were professional and efficient. They put the bed frame together and everything was set up and ready to go when they left. I was so happy with the quality of the products and service that I immediately ordered a bench online. Thanks JC Penney!

Same exact thing with the first one who reviewed this bed. Yet we got this earlier than them and returned it just recently. We have a Sterns & Foster mattress, which is a pretty heavy and descent one. The bed headboard, footboard and side rails are really nice but the veneer esp. on the side rails are chipping easily. The wooden slats that holds the mattress are somehow similar to wood crate but lighter and much inferior wood they used.. surely not a solid wood. It ends up warping in the middle esp. the ones that doesnt have a 1X1 post! clearly, the bed frame will not last even a year. Sad, because I couldnt find anything as nice as this design just yet.

The peasant top is made of a soft, smooth, almost silky feeling fabric (100% rayon), and polka dots look just like the picture! The sleeves hit just below the elbow, and it is somewhat a hi-lo top. It is longer in the front and back (easy to tuck in if desired), and elegantly curves to a shorter length at right and left sides.

The material in darker colors easily shows lint and dust particles, but I dont think this would be as noticeable in lighter colors. Instead of buttons, the fabric at the neck opening (with two vertical peep holes) is secured with horizontal fabric slashes, which is a nice feature since buttons generally pop of and dont add much design interest.

The material flows very well and feels like a bohemian peasant top- just as expected! The fabric does tend to wrinkle, and the washing label suggests washing in cold water, line dry (hand wash is recommended).
Overall, its a really stylish top, great for casual and business casual wear.

This mascara really takes your eyelashes and enhances them beautifully. My eyelashes are longer, curlier, and thicker with this mascara and I just love the way my eyes look when I use it!

The wand is admittedly a little bit different to use - youll run into problems with clumpiness when you use the wand vertically. Make sure to take off ALL excess mascara from the tip for the best results, and I dont use the wand totally vertically - but more at an upwards motion with the shape of my lash.

I cant see myself using another mascara... I have definitely transformed to the cult of Theyre Real! For reference - the left side in the image below is with Theyre Real! and the right is with no mascara to see the difference in lash length and definition!

I wore fake lashes for years and only recently started using mascara on my natural lashes. After reading TONS of reviews, I had narrowed down my choices to Benefit Theyre Real! or Dior Diorshow. They were both top sellers and top rated on several different sites. I went into the store to try them on before purchasing and fell in love with Benefit Theyre Real! I should admit, I loved this one so much I never sampled the Diorshow. This mascara added length and drama. My eyelashes are very fine, even with the special brush there was a clumpy look. I have never used a mascara that didnt give my lashes a clumpy look, I use a needle to get rid of clumps. As with any new mascara brush, it takes some practice to find the right technique. So far using another brush to get rid of access and using a single swipe rather than back and forth motion works best for my fine lashes. Worked great on my lower lashes as well. Overall, definitely the best mascara I have ever used! Only improvement would be a brush which collects less mascara, but this amount probably works for the majority.
Ive been using another mascara for over a year now that Im in love with (Mallys Volumizing Mascara) but was really intrigued by Benefits Theyre Real! Mascara so I had to try it out.

I like it, but I dont love it. There are some flaws for me - the main one being it goes on great with the first coat, but applying the second coat is a bit difficult. It becomes a little too thick and clump; you have to work the brush just right to make it look good and not spider-like. The other flaw was the brush wasnt the most comfortable on my lashes. I know that may not make a lot of sense, but the brush and bristles were harder than most other mascaras.

I like the final results, it passes my test for va-va-voom lashes, but Im not sure if I will re-purchase this in the future. Still, I recommend checking it out! Its a good mascara and may be the one for you!

I used to use liquid foundation because I thought it looked more natural and was very hesitant to try a powder one. I dont like powdery looks. I should have just tried this sooner because it really does a great job. I had originally considered/purchased this because I wanted a quick foundation. Both tinted moisturizer and liquid foundation are just too time consuming for every day use. With this, I can just put a tiny bit on the lid, swirl it, tap it and buff into my skin. Its so easy and the routine is actually fun for me whereas applying liquid foundation was kind of a drag.

I got this in the matte version because I have very oily skin, especially around the T-zone.With this, I stay oil free for a lot longer! When combined with mineral veil, I dont have to worry about blotting for at least 4-5 hours, which is nice for me. I no longer have to worry about shine.I gave this four stars because it does tend to crease on me after about 6 hours. Its not very noticeable, but its enough to make me keep my liquid foundation for special events.I should mention that this does not provide full coverage with a flawless face brush. Im sure you may get full coverage with the right brush, but not with the usual one. Think tinted moisturizer. If you want more coverage, one layer over the first should be enough (at least it is for me).Combined with concealer, my face looks great and natural although not entirely flawless, which is fine with me. I kind of prefer that it looks natural while covering up most of my imperfections instead of like doll skin.It is also best to use over a primer. When I use a primer, it covers more evenly and is easier to blend and does not exacerbate little bumps. I finish with mineral veil, and then UBs all nighter spray and I have not had any issues with this disappearing.Its great for photos too! I have tiny bumps on my forehead, but you can hardly see them in the photo.Also, the jar is huge! You get much more than I thought you did and I am very pleased with it, especially for such a reasonable price.

I hear that the dispenser is new as well. In the picture, you can see that the little holes are exposed, but if you turn the plastic cover, three little dimples click into place and keep your powder from coming out. Its very convenient for travel or to take with you in your purse.
Overall im very glad to have finally given this a try. Its not a miracle foundation, but its quick and it helps me look better without the breakouts or chemicals.

The Stafford collection, as far as shoes go are excellent. The price point you cant beat. I, originally was interested in the Deacon but already owned a pair of wing-tip boots so when the Gunners came out in Cognac, I was sold. You can find cap-toe boots from different makers for twice or thrice the price the Staffords run. In addition, JCP is constantly running deals so one will have the potential to get them half off.

The Gunners will go well with grey flannel trousers or khakis. Pick your poison. You are going to look sharp without spending a ton. I give these 5 stars all day!

Readers/Kilt Wearers-Greetings! These are the perfect Ankle Boot to wear with the Kilt, espc. if you are on a budget and cannot afford the pricey sorts. These Hi-Lows have a leather uppers, & a one piece sole with a non skid section. They cannot be resoled nor reheeled; so buy some heel plates to get more life from the Hi-Lows. The height is right for kilt wearing with the standard hose. They give good ankle support & keep the gravel out of your shoes! The brogue-ing is quite good, and overall construction is very good. They take a good shine, & will work for both Casual & Dress Kilt wearing occasions. The style is a good copy of the Edwardian mans shoe, this is the Era in which the kilt and its components took their present life and style. Thus it is the Right Style of Male Footwear to wear with the Kilt. I liked them well enough to order another pair in Black, again. I had wanted the Brown, but it is out of stocklikely forever And yes, I HAVE recommended these to many friends; via a Kilt wearing Forum. For the trowser wearing men, these should look suitable half covered by the trowsers cuff, but then you hide most of the footwear, and its style. On 2nd thought, stay with the Oxford/low cut shoes when you wear trowsers! In sum; a very good pair of Hi-Lows for the price.

For your money, Id say this is great value. These are nice sturdy leather boots. They do run large though. I normally wear a size 10.5 and instead I had to get a size 9.5 for these boots. Also the color is a little different from the picture in the description. It is more of a butterscotch color.Im happy with my purchase!

The gunner is a good boot, the leather quality is impressive for the price paid in the end. Comfortable, pretty durable, and with good depth to the leather this is worth picking up if you can find a good price on it. The only issue is that the shaft enclosure is a bit big but that isnt a problem as it breaks in.

These boot are great I was shopping around, and look at others for double the cost. I didnt know a sale was going on I was will to pay the original price , but the sale price was a great surprised so I bought two pair. They wear and feel great, so pleased to have made this purchase.
They are really comfortable. Recommend to buy, bc theyre good for any clothing actually. Fits the foot well and very stylish

Very nice looking boot and comfortable. Lined with glove leather is an especially nice touch. Made in Bangladesh, so it is not your usual Chinese product which is hit or miss. Bangladesh is adjacent to India, so the craftsmanship is much better. I always treat my boots with 50-50 boiled linseed oil and beeswax to preserve them and waterproof them. Noticed the leather although soft and supple absorbed this process and it took 6 treatments to finally seal them. Not a problem, but my process does darken the leather, which does not bother me as it protects my feet. Suspect that they must not oil these boots while they are in production, so if you buy them, you may want to use my treatment or simply put on the available mink oil, although that will darken the leather somewhat too. Other than that, an excellent buy and a very reasonable price too. I am very happy.

I got this Omega because the old Juicer i have does not extract all the juice out of the fruits and vegetables.Plus it is a mess to clean up.This Omega on the other hand is very easy to clean..easy to assemble and quiet.The only thing, i did not like so far from using it just one time..is that it shakes little while juicing perhaps, i did not attach nozzle into the front part too well so i will have to check that the next time, i juice.Also..I had to cut up fruits and veggies smaller to fit into the tube shoot...to feed into the grinder.Which took juicing much longer time wise.Plus..when you use this juicer..always use the fruits that are hard..if you do not..then Alternate between the softer fruits and veggies to harder ones..Which makes the extraction at the end better to keep things moving and not get the machine feeding tube clogged up.Other than that..I am excited to have this juicer and hope to have it for a long long time.I will say that i have read that you cannot put the rinds/skins of Oranges and Lemons into the grinder also, Coconut.It breaks the grinder..since it is plastic.Avoid those things to juice in this Omega.However, i did use 1/2 of a lemon with the rind and it was able to grind without a problem.I did cut it into very small pieces which i am sure helped.Do not run Omega for long..Take time to stop and start ..Do not run machine for more than 30 mins long when juicing.Always take time..and let machine relax and rest..to avoid any parts from cracking ..I have read many reviews and people have had issues with the grinder or blank cracking or wearing down.

Ive had my 8006 for nearly four years now and its been with me everywhere. Ive worked with the Norwalk Juicer, the Nutrifast Juicer, a few Brevilles and I have always remained very pleased with this juicer because of its efficiency and quality in comparison to the others. The only (minor) con I could list would be while juicing pineapple; It produces a lot of foam for whatever reason and the pulp seems to often get trapped in the drum. For everything else aside, every fruit and veggie under the sun, they all work great with this juicer. If choosing this juicer, have awareness that youll have to cut your produce up in smaller pieces to fit in the mouth. It isnt bothersome to me, but it may lengthen the time it takes to prepare juice. This juicer is worth every cent and makes you some money back in terms of the quantity of juice it makes from the produce your using. Omega is truly a top quality brand at a more affordable price.

My only complaint is the time necessary to cut all the veggies & fruits small enough to fit the narrow feed tube, but thats an issue with all masticating-type juicers & isnt a reflection on the Omega 8006 particularly. Ive also made frozen ice creams & sherbets from fruits with this juicer (using the blank screen) as well as grinding soaked nuts & seeds for loaves & burger patties. I have an 8 year old Polar F1 that still works, but the transmitter belt has finally deteriorated (the plastic ends broke through). This FT1 is very similar, but the watch band looks suspect. I just received this, have used it two days and am concerned the gel-rubber band may not last. I will update over time. The one-button entries have a short learning curve and you wont regret the simplicity. After entering execute (start) you merely swipe your wrist past the chest sensor to toggle between heart rate, elapsed time and actual clock time. No buttons to push while working out! This is basic; no upload or tracking, but gives you right-now feedback of your workout intensity. The LARGE font is easy on these 60 YO eyes and preferable (to me) over the FT4/7 Polars watch face and font size. The band is the only reason to not give it 5 stars.

After less than 3 months of use, the transmitter was not sending a signal. I replaced the battery replaced and verified that the belt had a conductive connection to my skin. Still no signal. I was doubly irritated because my skin on either side of the POLAR transmitter battery holder was red and raw with a rash. Realized in reading about fixes that the belt had leaked the connective gel/fluid and caused the rash.

Its a good value, does the few things it does well. A good choice for a first heart rate monitor while youre deciding how much money to invest. The official battery replacement method is going to cost you as much as a whole new unit, so consider it disposable after a year or two of use. There are videos on replacing the battery yourself, but it may ruin the waterproofing and will definitely void the warranty.

We have recently moved into a new home and purchased this fridge to compliment our new kitchen. I also admit that I am a SS junkie, with 2 small grandchildren and a dog. Smudge/finger print free living is absolutely the way to go. I honestly dont know how I survived without it. I love the convenience of being able to switch one of the freezer compartments into a standard fridge, for any over flow during holidays and parties. I rarely write reviews, yet I felt this little fridge deserved a serious pat on the back. Thanks Samsung designers, you hit a home run on this one.

The 2 vegetable and fruit drawers are large and accommodate all bulky items. It is necessary to lift the adjustable shelf to fit tall wine bottles but milk will fit on the top shelf or in the door shelves also. Unfortunately for me the fridge could not be pushed all the way into counter depth due to a beveled pantry wall that impacted the door when fully opened....my fault again.Otherwise i love it...what an improvement to the overall look in my kitchen. One finally thought the stainless steel is NOT finger proof nor is it it magnetic, i will have to find a new location for my grandkids pics and grocery list.

This new refrigerator replaced a Whirlpool that only lasted 9 years. This 4 door flex is beautiful. I got the black Stainless steel and looks so nice. I love the flexibility of the shelves. There is so much room . The lights inside are very bright and the it is very quiet. I love that is has an alarm so you know if the door did not shut. I really cannot say enough good things. I do hope it will last for many years.
We recently upgraded our appliances and this was without a doubt, the best fridge we couldve chosen. The color is amazing, no fingerprints! Strongly recommend.

I cant say that I am the most learned of refrigerator shoppers, but we had an allowance to choose our own appliances with our new home purchase. I ended up with a crash course. We had friends who warned us about the problems with the drawer freezer in french door refrigerators, so we were very wary of them. The french door models all looked very nice but we had a second issue - our space was shallow so we needed a counter depth fridge. This meant we would lose more fridge space.

Enter this model - it had the perfect solution to both of our issues. It has two regular upright freezer panels down below. Even better, one of the panels (the bottom right) can switch to become a fridge instead of a freezer. Since we dont usually keep lots of frozen items, we just turned the lower right space into a drink fridge, freeing up tons of room in the main fridge.

All of the functions work fine but I really think that this design is very good for addressing the two issues we had. I suspect that there are lots of people with similar restrictions, so if so, I would look closely at this model.

I love the style, features, controls and overall look of this unit. Im disappointed, however, in the functionality of the door compartments on the left side, especially how they wrap around. You can only fit one stick of butter in that tiny space....... Its almost useless in my opinion. No butter keeper either. I also dont like how the very back of the fridge seems to curve forward and the glass top of the drawers leaves a ridge back there. On the top glass shelf , it doesnt go all the way to the back of the fridge so things fall down in between to the second level.My other complaint is the rear slope of the vegetable keepers. Theyre deep, but so much room is wasted by that slope.This is the first time I had a counter depth fridge and I guess Im used to the standard ones. I should have tried to get the 24 or larger one to fit into my space when I re-decorated.Overall, Im happy with the performance and I REALLY LOVE the baskets in freezer sections. So much nicer than wire baskets or a couple of deep wells to dig through

Hello Samsung - Are You Listening? This refrigerator is a great style, and really like the counter depth. Regarding the flex door - what a great idea. However, to make it more functional for use as a beverage center, it needs some additional accessories, like a multi can holder, or wine rack insert. The drawers and pull out top shelf dont work well for beverages, and the door doesnt hold much. Is there anything available or is there any other accessories coming in the future?

It would also be useful to use it as actual refrigerator temp, if that would be available in the future. The 41 degrees is too warm for regular refrigerator items. If I remember correctly, the next temperature setting is around 30?
There is a gurgling noise when the unit cycles off and on, and am going to call for service, to see if that can be quieted. Four star performance rating because of this noise.

I bought 2 colors - Lilac and Deep Purple, since purple shades compliment my green eyes very well!!I have been using them for a good while now and I have to say I am very impressed with the quality of the product and specially the price you pay.

The application is very smooth, it almost feels a gel like eyeliner in pencil form - so you get no tugging or pulling because of the softer formula (on either top or bottom lash line) with super nice pigmentation pay off. Even though the formula is softer I was still able to make my liner as thin or thick as I wanted and make nice wing.Ones applied you have to work extremely quick if you want to smudge the applied pencil line, because if you wait too long it will stay put and not go anywhere (so you might have to apply the product to one eye at a time and blend it out, and then move on to the other eye - this would be a must have process if you are working on a wing liner). I would not say that it is amazingly waterproof, but it is definitely water resistant.Sharpening the pencils was not a problem at all, I did not notice any breaking of the pencil during the whole process, so you will not waste any product (well as long as you have a good sharpener).

I love applying the Lilac shade on my water line or the lower lash line as a tiny pop of color , especially for day time make up .Deep Purple shade looks amazing on both upper and lower lashline/waterline - it is deeper shade that depending on the lighting will change color from true royal purple to slightly bluish purple.The staying power on upper and lower lash lines is about 8+ hours with extremely minimal fading. Waterline on the other hand is about 4+ hours (but that is about normal for me, because typically eyeliners do not last on my waterline too much).

The rug that I ordered, based on the picture, is NOT the rug that I received. The rug that I received is a simplified, crude version of what is pictured. In the photo, the rug has what is often called a ring of wheat leaves, immediately outside the central blank area, and then just beyond that are parallel ropes, with crosses above the smaller four outside medallions, and small accent lines crossing the ropes at the corners above the larger four outside medallions. The rug that I received has no ropes, just parallel lines with random messy spots of another color in them, the four smaller outside medallions have been eliminated (this may be needed in the 5 size, but should be described and/or pictured), and there are no crosses and no lines across what should have been ropes. The pattern of the wool has random spots of other colors where they should not be. At the edges, the fabric sewn to the bottom shows badly. Not only is this design a crude version of what was pictured, it is a poorly executed example of the crude version of the design. The rug in the photo is a well made rug. This was recommended to me by a rep at the Sephora at Water Tower Place in chicago. David, youre a rockstar, and im so grateful for you.

Ive only been using this for 10 days, but the results are amazing. I was given the opportunity to try the Opal. I looked fine to myself. But, in pictures (due to a recent weight loss, mostly in my face) I looked like every part of my face was drooping. This was after the best new products out there in makeup. HD and all. So, I tried the OPAL and wore no makeup to take a few pictures. I promise!, I looked better after two treatments (30 seconds for each eye or deep wrinkle) without makeup in a picture than I did spending two hours trying to cover up the premature weight loss aging! I love the opal.....
After the first use, it diminishes fine lines around eyes and lips. The gel moisturizer is very luxurious ---smooth and silky and all natural.
I gave it 4 stars only because of the price. (I know beauty has it;s price but this one is rather large considering the very small area you treat with it!)
Here are a few things to know:

They do not reccomend you use with any other moisturizer or eye creams but their own formulation which is conveniently housed in the lid of the device. You could layer your eye creme on top as their formulation is water based and wont act as a barrier to your cremes but I really dont think youll need it...the gel supplied is again - fab.
1 gel cartridge should last about 30 days depending on use (just eyes or eyes and lips etc...) You really dont use much more than 2-3 drops per eye.

It has a supper soft and supple silicone applicator tip that will need replaced periodically - they reccomend - every 3 months. (Basically you put a few drops of gel in the slicone cup and then apply to face - the sonic vibration ensures the gel is deposited into all those knooks and crannies in the skin.)
It easily fits in the plam of your hand is very portable - if taking on vacation etc...just charge it before you leave so you font have to take the cord with you.

While it is made for your eyes & very soft and gentle---you do not use on eyelids or along lashline. You use just under lashline and corners of eyes - between eyes for crows feet but NOT directly on lids or along lashes.
In the one photo uploaded - I did a size comparison with a tube of lipstick.
In the second - just a look at the tip and the underside lid where gel eye moistuizer is dispensed.

And we have a lot of parties. Weve found ways to get a LOT of dishes in this compact device, which is quieter than dishwashers I remember from childhood.
It took us a few months to discover the ideal detergent: Cascade Complete Pacs. Until we made that discovery, we were seeing a film on dishes. Since then, everything is great.

High quality bristles and allows for even distribution of foundation. I use it for concealer or highlighter because it is smaller and geared for targeting smaller areas, but you could also use it for the entire face.

This brush is absolutely amazing, for so many reasons- mostly the fact that it can do so many things, and do them so perfectly that it really seems pointless to own another foundation brush. Between this and your fingers, youre pretty set, unless you wanted to get more than one of this same brush- that sounds good to me!

i use the new NARS super lightweight luminous foundation, and this brush really makes it easy to start in the center and work outward because you can get it in the more narrow areas around your eyes and nose and just glide it outward so smoothly in a very easy way. from there you can just spread it really thin with your fingers if you want to. This also works incredibly well to work in the NARS radiant creamy concealer after dabbing that under the eyes and around the nose, etc, because the shape is so perfect for that. I also like to contour with a dark foundation shade and this brush fits really well into the hollows of my cheeks, and it also works incredibly well for highlighting the same way, with a lighter shade.

I bought this specifically for contouring with a darker shade of foundation but there are just so many great uses for it and its lovely to apply and blend with so I end up just using it for any and everything even though I have over 80 high end makeup brushes to choose from. This is a MUST HAVE brush.

I love this brush. It really deserves more attention. It is perfect for applying primer and foundation. It doesnt leave much traces like other thicker bigger brushes do. The hair is thin enough to create a dewy look while stay firm all together to help with shaping and contouring purposes. You will find many uses with this brush, especially the tip of it helps with detailing.
Amazing quality and perfect for contouring.

I saw these roman shades in the catalog and loved that they were cotton, lined, and very nice looking and were on sale. I ordered 4 in the soft beige color. To preface this, my hair is originally brunette and Ive been getting balayage for over two years. It is also thin, but I have a lot of it. So my hair can easily become damaged during the bleaching.
As of recently its become unruly due to the length, layers, bleaching, etc. I take great care of my hair, but I needed something else.

I just used this mask this morning and I cant stop touching my hair!!! I would brush a section of my hair, then wet the brush and brush that section again, & then apply the mask. I did this to my whole head. I left it on for 10-15 mins and then popped in the shower. I left it on in the shower for about 3 more mins to get the warm steam.

I feel as though I should add that I dont regularly shampoo; one to two times a month. When I do, I use the purple shampoo to strip out the brassy-ness that can happen to blondes. Usually when I shampoo with this my hair becomes a nest, but after rinsing out the mask & using this shampoo, there were no issues!!!
Long story short - great price for a fantastic product!!!
This is one of my favorite hair masks! It helped my hair a lot when it was really damaged from being colored and it never weighed it down. Not a heavy fragrance either which I appreciate!
I used the mask twice. I noticed a difference at first, but still needed to use the flat iron to tame my hair. it looked good until I had to wash it again. I was expecting more permanent results.

Upon opening, first impression of this was that it was THICK, which i love! The smell wasnt pleasant, kind of reminded me of a dentist office but it wasnt horrible. I felt a difference the first time i used it but i wasnt 100% sold. I continued use and by the 3rd use my hair was noticeably shinier, soft and moisturized. It was so soft it kept falling out of my hair tie. I use with my tangle tamer and let it sit in my hair while I shower. My hair is long, fine and slightly damaged by highlights. I will be re-purchasing this product once it comes back in stock. It works for me and the price is very reasonable in my opinion.
Caviar and Living Proof step aside! This is the best mask ever!!! Does not smell anything but delicious. Leaves your hair soft ... Even my greys.
I used this as a deep treatment and sat under a steamer for 15 minutes. My hair came out soft, shiny, and even feels stronger.

I was nervous about ordering this as when I tried it on in the store, the same size I ordered, it was SO difficult to get on. I received a sample of the Phyto 7 from Sephora and really liked it. So, I decided to purchase Phyto 9 based on the current condition of my hair. My hair is fairly long and the outer cuticle tends to get dry especially during the winter months. I was also suffering from split ends.I have found Phyto 9 to be phenomenal!!! This quickly improved the condition of my hair. I was getting some frizziness from my hair being dry - not any more! And, this stuff is amazing for split ends! I know the price point looks high. I prefer to use hair products that are nature rather than chemically based. I highly recommend this to anyone with dry hair or split ends.

I purchased beach and its the perfect shade for my medium toned skin. I often look rosy and everything turns orange on me. This does not and is a really great match. I am absolutely in love with this brush. Brilliant for applying glitter/pigments with even coverage.

My mother introduced me to Bare Minerals two years ago. I am 32 yrs. old and get mistaken for a high school girl constantly at my job. I like this concealer because it is light and a very good color match. Plus, it has SPF! The coverage leaves something to be desired, but its decent nonetheless. Its not a miracle concealer for me. You cant go wrong with this multi tasking product. Lighter shades can be used for highlighting cheekbones, brows and darker shades can be used as a subtle eye shadow primer or even sheer cheek color. I used it especially in the summer when my skin was in between shades, it mixes perfectly with BareMinerals mineral foundation! Highly recommended!

I have long had a problem with dark under eye circles and puffy eyes. Well-Rested from BareMinerals completely hides them and makes them look bright and awake. It is not cakey at all like most under eye concealers and lasts along time. A little bit goes a long way!

This is a great follow up to the first Naked Palette, and in my opinion includes more cool colors than the first Naked. I am disappointed that UD included a dupe of Half Baked in this palette, and I also feel that if you have a lot of other UD palettes that there will be other repeated colors in Naked 2 (see attached picture for some comparisons), but overall this palette has colors that work well together (which makes it great for travel) and is the same high quality, soft, blendable eyeshadows that we all expect from UD.I definitely do not think that you *need* to own both Naked 1 and 2, however they are different enough that owning both is not completely repetitive.Also, I have to say that I really like the Lip Junkie formula; it is a great gloss that is not sticky and leaves my lips soft and hydrated. The Naked color adds just a tiny bit of a pinkish tint to my lips (but my natural lip color is not very dark), so this gloss may not show color on everyone.

I like the eyeshadows but I am very unpleased with what happened with these two eyeshadows in my pallet. They just got loose from the pallet and the black one ruined foxy witch is the light coloured one on the other end. I dont think that this should happen in such high quality pallets because nothing happend to it the glue just didnt hold the eyeshadows.
As someone who is more on the fairly light side of the color spectrum, I gotta say that this go around with the Naked collection is the one that has me going crazy!!

I love how the colors are cooler nakeds, giving me a wide range of colors to do a day look, a night look, and everything inbetween! The colors are highly pigmented, and with a primer theyre super long wearing.

The double ended brush is pretty nice. I was skeptical at first, but the quality is great!! The lip junkie in Naked that it comes with is also nice. Very pretty pale pink, and I like the cooling sensation it gives to my lips as well.
I am a HUGE fan of the packaging! Bigger mirror, metal case that fully closes?! YES PLEASE!!
I got one before all my friends, and I dont shut up about how they need this product in their lives. Great buy!!

This was my 1st UD shadow purchase. I have a close friend who LOVES UDs shadows & shadow pallets, so needless to say, she was an influence on this purchase.& Im happy with it! I totally dig it.* 1 thing- LESS MATTES in ur pallets, UD! PLZ!I know that this request is opposite to the other reviews, but my friends & I all feel the same, we like shimmery shadows. NOT GLITTER, NOT MATTE, SHIMMER. Theyre the best. Theres no denying it ;)U guys (UD) made a little matte pallet to appease ur matte-loving customers, how about a little shimmer pallet???* (I know there were only 4 mattes in the Naked 2 pallet, but to us, its 4 TOO MANY!!! Theyre a waste to ppl like myself & my friends. MORE SHIMMER, LESS MATTE, PRETTY PLEASE WITH SUGAR & SHIMMER ON TOP???);D

I have the Naked 1 palette, and i love it. I dont use any other eyeshadows other than that palette. I bought the Naked 2 palette, hesitant because of how similar it is to the original Naked palette. Naked 2 is a bit too similar to the original Naked palette. I would have like to see some different shades. One thing i do like better about Naked 2, is the brush that came with it. The blending brush was an awesome change the the Naked palettes. The pigmentation is equal in both Naked and Naked 2. If i had to choose between the two though, i would choose the original Naked 1 palette.

This is my new favorite shadow box. There are more shimmers than matte, but enough to work with either way, depending on the effect Im going for. Plus, all of these shades are being touted as the it shades heading into fall/winter. The heavy-duty stylized tin is like the SUV of containers--love it. The dual-headed brush is decent; thinner works great for the details, and the larger brush is good for a sweep of color. The mauve-ish lip gloss is fantastic, too. I only wish it came in a bigger tube because it works very well over my matte Sephora lip stains which can be a bit dry.

This is a great palette, and is complimentary to Naked 1. It is cooler in tone overall, although there are still definitely some warm shades (Chopper, Half Baked, YDK). I think I do still prefer my Naked 1 however, simply because there are more dark/smokey shades in that one, so there are more options for a smokey eye than there are with the Naked2. Im still happy I have it though, and if your budget allows and you love neautrals, I think you do need both. :) There are no bad shadows in this palette, quality is great overall, and the brush is soft and applies well!

I wouldnt buy both this and the original Naked, because they are really similar, but this is a fantastic alternative if youre looking for more cool tones. Great quality, as usuals from UD.If youre looking for ideas, or want to see what you can do with this palette, I did a tutorial using a lot of the shadows in this palette for a slightly smokey neutral eye look. Hope it helps!

I use this product in Luminous and Aura. I use the shade Aura for highlighting, especially on my cheekbones, and I use Luminous as I would a bronzer (usually after I put on my regular bronzer or alone if I want a very natural yet bronzed look) as I have very fair skin. The smell of this product is really nice and in the shower my hair felt amazing keep in mind I have long curly thick hair I dont put anything on my hair I just let it air dry which I did my hair never felt so dry so I thought maybe I didnt use it right . I did my research you are suppose to wash your hair towel dry it put this conditioner on leave it for 20 min than wash it out.. No one got time for that are you serious.

I have fine, thinning, oily, color treated hair that was quickly turning into straw. I had to wash every two days because of the grease. The first time I used the product I was not impressed - it did not do anything a good conditioner would not do. However, after the second and third use I really felt the difference. My hair was silky soft and shiny. It felt fuller and looked healthier than it had in ages - bouncing like no bodys business. It hydrates without weighing my hair down and trust me when I say my hair is easily weighed down. I am very happy with this product.

This product is amazing! Works wonders after first use. I have thin, straight hair with the bottom portion color treated before. This product makes my hair so shiny and soft without weighing them down. The only down side of this is the smell, which I do not like so much. Other than that, this is the best hair mask I have ever used. Will definitely be repurchasing this again!! Highly, highly recommend!

These are wonderful. Theyre cozy cotton sweaters in pleasant colors, and they last. I bought about six last winter and wore them almost constantly all season, to find that when I tried one on today it still fits perfectly and is snuggly-warm.

Relatively easy do-it-yourself installation due to thoughtful design that places adjustment screws for rear leg height at front of unit. Very quiet, but not completely silent, as some reviewers suggest. My unit may make more noise because I installed an air gap at the sink. I absolutely love the clean flat front with no protrusions since I had to install the dishwasher at a right angle to adjacent cabinet, allowing drawers to open in front of the face of the dishwasher with ample clearance. The hybrid drying system has worked flawlessly--dishes and glasses come out squeaky clean and spotless. My favorite feature is the top rack only cycle that saves water and energy for the majority of our dishwashing needs. The LDS5540ST has plenty of capacity on board when we entertain family and friends. Has been in use for one week--will update if reliability issues arise. The only thing missing is a rinse & hold cycle; however, I just start a cycle, then cancel after a few minutes of 1st rinse.

I really do like this appliance. The only knock I have on it is a minor one. The issue I have is with the silverware basket. It is not conveniently placed in the dishwasher, and the way it is set up, you either need to dump all the silverware out in a damp pile to sort it, or you need to grab the eating surface, which is less than ideal.
I understand that there is an (optional) third row silverware rack that comes with some LG models and it appears that this would resolve the issue.

I hate to nitpick, because this is truly a great dishwasher. It is virtually silent and the dishes come out very clean. But since packing and unpacking the dishwasher are my job, I deal with this issue daily. A little more attention to the silverware rack would have made a difference to me.
One alternative might be to make the third rack available for all models. This would likely generate additional sales for LG and a (slightly) more satisfied customer.

I normally go:Base coat -> 2 coats of formula X -> Top Coat.(One swipe wasnt enough to be opaque, as you can see in the picture I attached)

Also, the swatches on the Sephora site can be misleading.For example, Paramount was supposed to be a sage gray which sounds gorgeous, but it was more of a concrete gray.

I first tried Formula X at a Sephora event in NYC--they had nail artists there doing mini manicures & nail art on people attending the event. I chose Dark Matter, the black shade. I have to say I was skeptical because I like OPI and so I didnt know what to expect from the new Formula X. Fast forward to NINE DAYS later, and my manicure is still mostly intact. I included pics below of day 1 and day 9 so you can see the difference. Most of my fingers arent even chipped at all--just a little bit on my left thumb & index finger. Even with those couple of little chips, I seriously cant believe how good this polish still looks after over a week of wear. No matter what brand of polish I use, or whether I do it myself or in the salon, my mani is usually toast in five days, tops. Not only did this stay on well, but it also still looks really glossy and fresh, not all battered and dingy like polish can get once youve had it on for a while. i didnt reapply topcoat either. Im really excited to try more colors of this polish--it really is amazing (and nice to know that if you want to do nail art at home, your hard work isnt just going to flake off in two days).

I was super excited when I first saw the Formula X polishes because theres such a huge wide range of colors. The first color that tried was Curiosity, which is a beautiful red shade, basically a pure red. For Christmas my brother picked me up Connectivity, which is really hard to explain, but its like a grayish bronze with small glittery metallic look. Its gorgeous and definitely more wearable than you may think. It stayed for 6 days, which is pretty impressive, but what I would expect for a glitter polish. My mom also gave me Fearless for Christmas, which is a pretty netural sage green. I love neutrals to death, and this is unlike any other color I own. The color looks really pretty on me, and I think it would look great on anyone for any season. But biggest complain with Formula though is the brush. I find the brush is just impossible to use and not get nail polish everywhere. I like to think Im good at painting my nails, but this brush is hard. Its streaky, too fat, either picks up not enough or too much polish, and too long to control. I also found Fearless to be kind of sticky and tacky, which was odd considering the packaging stops people from opening it in store. The cream colors only last for about 3-5 days, which is not really impressive, just standard in my opinion. However, because of the pretty shade range, I dont doubt that I will be purchasing more in the future.

I was very skeptical about the new Formula X polishes, but when I was shopping around I saw a nude color that I liked a lot. After thinking a bit I decided to go ahead and purchase it. The color I picked is Standout. It was not too white, yellow/brown or pink - its enough to stand out on my nails when compared to skin color!

The formula applied well, smooth and it was not overly streaky on the first coat (I think it streaked only on 2 of my nails) and no streaks on the second. It felt slightly thick, but it did not bother me - because I was able to work with it very well. Also one of the things I have noticed that even without the top coat polish was super shiny (omg it was awesome!).
In terms of wear - well, it lasted on me 3 days with no chipping at all !!! On the 4th day I noticed some tiny tip wear, and on the 5th day - I saw major chipping! Over all I was very impressed.
The Nude polish selection is great, so I would definitely recommend it!

Ive made a couple other reviews since I purchased several Formula X nail polishes over a month ago. I cant believe some reviews say it chips or peels quickly?! I am very hard on my hands and have tried EVERY nail polish brand, top coat, base coat, system on the planet, and Fomula X is by FAR the best nail polish SYSTEM ever! You must use the base coat and top coat for longevity, dont substitute or skip if you want LONG LASTING nail polish. The top coat is amazing, and dries fast. The Formula X system make my nail polish last easily over 6 days with NO chipping or peeling,, and the ONLY reason I change it is because I want to try out another fabulous color,

I get TONS of compliments on my nails with Formula X, people think Ive had them professionally done. The thicker formula makes the nails look amazing, shiny, incredible. Here is my latest color called Extraordinary, a light grey, and I added the gold studs for fun.

I loved the old Sephora X nail polish system and when was discontinued, I was disappointed to say the least. If youre one of those people (like me!) who has been frustrated trying every brand of nail polish, base coat, top coat, but it all chips in a day, get Formula X, you will be happy you did! Make sure you get the base and top coat too, they are formulated to use together for long wear & chip resistant finish.

I love nail polish, however, I find Im often disappointed with either the wear or the look of the polish. The opposite happened with the Formula X. I will say that I was irritated at first. I bought The System and ended up picking out the color Heart-Stopping. When I got home I unpackaged everything, and was able to open up the bottles, except for the actual color! That one is wrapped in a plastic wrap, which I had to remove, and would absolutely not open. I ended up with a small blister from trying to open it. I finally ran the bottle under some hot water, and it opened up. I noticed that some of the nail polish had dried and crusted on the part of the bottle that screws.
Ill start with the cons:-Thin long brush (Im used to a wider brush)

Now the pros: (which are kind of cons too!)-Super fast drying (which means you need to get your layers perfect the first time)-Really thick formula (Im used to doing thin layers of polish, this requires a bit thicker layer than Im used to.)-Very opaque

I am the kind of person who loves to peel off nail polish. This nail polish had minimum chipping, which was awesome. I tried to peel the nail polish off, and that was nearly impossible, which was another great thing for me.

I love Formula X. Ive tried other brands of nail polish and they all had issues... they chipped too soon, dried too slowly, or were only shiny for one day. Formula X blows all of those old nail polishes out of the water.

The system works wonderfully. The second color I tried was Fathom. Great coverage, wonderful color. Its more of a blue gray. I only had to use 1 coat of color because the color was so opaque, and the one coat covered fully. I used the top coat, waited about 5 minutes then used the drying spray. It dried incredibly fast... I love the color and the shine is fantastic. Its still wearing fabulously.
I have recommended this system to many people. I am hooked and recently purchased 4 more shades. Formula X is the best Ive tried.

Measure TWICE (including mattress and pillow height), buy ONCE.I chose the FULL/QUEEN Worn Indigo Royal Velvet® Abigail Matelassé Coverlet for my Queen size bed. I chose wrong because I didnt measure my mattress and pillow heights. The Full/Queen coverlet: 92W x 96L dimensions were too narrow to cover the mattress, top sheet, pillows, and blanket. Even the 96 length is 3-6 too short, in my opinion. I think this coverlet is better for a Full bed, but too narrow for most Queen beds with 10 or higher mattresses. You might be okay if your Queen bed has a basic and simple 8 high mattress. Most Queen beds these days have 10 or higher mattresses. I may purchase the Full bedspread: 104W x 114L in the future, to replace my 92W x 96L coverlet. I also have the matching bed skirt, but may not need the bed skirt after I get the 104W x 114L Full size bedspread. I dont need to completely hide the floor area under the bed, so the full bedspread should be okay without a bed skirt. The full bedspread will not completely hide the floor under my bed, but it will fully cover my mattress, top sheet, pillows, and blanket.Measure TWICE (including mattress and pillow height), buy ONCE.

Regarding the bed skirt, de-wrinkle it BEFORE placing it. Instead of ironing, I rinse and spin dry the skirt in the washer, then tumble it in the dryer on a LESS automatic permanent press setting, until the bed skirt is DAMP (slightly wet). I place the skirt on the bed while it is still damp and pull/tug on its bottoms. I searched and also found a tip about Downy Wrinkle Releaser.

Lets just say it is what my wife and I have been looking for in a car seat. In the lifetime of your baby you know you are bound to have two car seats or three. Were going to just stick will two - baby carrier and this Graco - 4Ever All in 1. The Graco 4Ever All-in-1 Car Seat allows for rear seating and forward seating 5lbs to 110 lbs. The rear seating is what we love best because it comes with the click latch and also the best part is it has recline levels to allow for almost near flat. Why do we love this so much is because our baby can sit comfortably and also sleep comfortably. The next best thing about the Graco 4Ever All-in-1 Car Seat is the it has multiple adjustments for forward facing, of course when you baby is not longer an infant or toddler, the head rest adjusts up to when they are ready to sit in a grown up seat. Would recommend this product - safety ratings are great and also not mention the infant additional cushions.

I love this car seat, but for the price you really could have put way more thought into the execution of this head support. That dinky piece of elastic does not hold it in place and I constantly have to reassemble it before I can put my child in the seat. You should consider building a column of sorts and making the stem longer so that it inserts into the body support and stays there even when you adjust other parts of the car seat. Everybodys baby is not short so this should have been taken into consideration when designing the head/body support insert for this car seat. I have been using this car seat since he was born and the head support has consistently been the most annoyingly nonfunctional part of this seat!

This car seat was a breeze to install using the latch system in my vehicle. I have only used it rear-facing so far, but my 6 month old loves it after a few days of adjustment. He sits up higher than in the infant seat so he can see out the window so much better, keeping him quiet and entertained. The only complaint and reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is the harness is quite difficult to tighten. I read somewhere to pull the slack out of the harness from the back of the car seat and then finish adjusting on the front by pulling the strap down by his feet. This seems to work much better, but still a bit of pain compared to the ease of my infant seat.

I absolutely LOVE this carseat. We got it for our 8 month old thats almost 25lbs. He loves it and is so much more comfortable in this than his infant carseat. My favorite features are that you dont have to rethread the straps when you adjust the height. Also it is super easy to install, no more than a few minutes the first time, and very easy to switch between vehicles. The seat also has 3 recline positions for rear-facing and 3 positions for forward-facing. It is very easy to take the cover/padding off to wash, and the fabric is very high quality material. The ONLY thing I have found that I am not fond of is the fact that the cup holders will only fit a standard size bottle such as dr. Brown. Definitely no sippy cups or wide mouth bottles. All in all I would say it is VERY worth every penny we paid (some would say a little expensive such as my husband) but considering the weight limit is 120 lbs and the fact that you will never have to buy another carseat or booster it is very worth it.
