I read up and review product feedback before making any purchase. Took a chance on this because I REALY wanted a waffle iron like they have one of my favorite hotels. Review complained about the 1 - handle folding up, 2 - being hard to clean and 3 - no indicator when the waffles are done. My thoughts:

1 - The handle needs to lock in place to make people happy. It doesnt. I paid 19.99 for it March of 2015. I was not expecting high quality, just that is worked as described. My handle did no fold in on me while cooking. It stayed pretty stable. Had no problems.

2 - I let my iron cool in the closed position, came back a 1/2 an hour later and wiped down with a damp paper towel. No oil build up after 2 Saturday mornings in a row. I did wipe extra moisture with a dry paper towel at the end.

3 - The iron has a light telling you when it is hot enough to use. I poured 1/3 cup of waffle batter plus a little extra to have a fully shaped finished waffle. After you flip the waffle maker it steams and mine had a green light that lit up when it was done. I played around with the darkness dial on the top and my family like it right in the middle. We use Kruetez pancake mix with the option waffle mix change - 1 egg and a little oil. Made 6 waffles for a family of 3. No complaints.
Please note in the direction it tells you NOT to eat the first waffle you make in it. Agreed - when I pulled it from the maker it smelled slightly of the plastic and packaging materials.

One other comment made in some reviews was regarding sticking. I used a silicon basting brush with a little oil to swipe on bottom and top plates between each waffle. I also used small serving tongs to remove the finish waffle.
Im happy with my purchase.

I was skeptical to buy this device at first because of the price tag for such a small size. I was a Clarisonic user for about a year and was just never fully satisfied. I always felt like my brush heads were dirty no matter what I did to clean them. The inside of the device started to get tiny mold spores from water being trapped in there. I could never get it out! I also hated having to charge my device as much as I did. However, after I finally decided to buy the Luna Mini, I will NEVER go back. I love it!! Its waterproof, hygienic, and it stays charged for a long time!! I have used mine almost everyday for two months and havent had to charge it yet. I can get it wet and it never molds or smells funny. Now, my skin is very sinister and dehydrated and this has never irritated my skin. My skin is always very soft after cleansing and it honestly looks cleaner than it does if I only use my hands. That sounds like a load of bs, but I promise you will see a difference in your skin as well. Trust me, and try this device!

I am completely in love with this device...my skin looks seriously flawless after less than 2 weeks use. I wasnt going to write a review this soon, but I am just that impressed and it has made a difference very quickly. I havent had major acne or anything, but I do have clogged pores and some hyper pigmentation on my temples. I have normal to combination skin. Because I use chemical exfoliants (most recently the Drunk Elephant TLC Glycolic Night Serum with BHA & AHA) I felt like using a Clarisonic would be too aggressive on my skin and overexfoliate. So when I read a ton of good reviews and watched a video on YouTube of a Beautypedia review of this product (check it out, it has some helpful info...they say it doesnt matter which device you get the $99 or $169 one the results are the same) I had to try it since it supposed to be gentler on your skin than the Clarisonic. I was VERY skeptical it would work, and actually thought the silicone bristles would actually impact my pores and make them more clogged. I was impressed after the first use. My face was super soft and it did bring up some of the gunk that had been in my pores that my BHA could not get out. Really impressive because I swear by chemical exfoliants. Initially the first few days my skin did go through a minor purging period where it was bringing up debris from my pores that had been deep in my skin. But after those few days my skin is literally glowing. I have seen the edges around my dark spots start to fade because I believe it helps my serum and other treatments sink in deeper than they normally would. I even use it around my eyes which usually get drier than the rest of my face and my makeup settles into my squinting lines under my eyes. After using this for almost two weeks my eyes look much smoother with makeup on mainly because I think my moisturizer and serum is able to penetrate deeper. I noticed last night that I had a milia bump by my eye (a stubborn little whitehead that are impossible to get fid of) and it is completely gone! I am still able to use my Drunk Elephant Glycolic Serum with no problems or sensitivity. This is very gentle, I dont feel like I am scrubbing off my face. I do only use it at night though. It is very easy to use and keep clean. The way it is made it fits easily into your palm and can get into the crevices of your face and around and under your eyes. It feels nice to use, I even have my hubby using it also! I cant compare it to the Clarisonic but just because this is a gentle cleansing device it packs a mighty punch in getting your face cleaner than you have ever seen, seriously. Sorry for the long review, but this is an investment you should research before buying so I hope this was helpful! This little gem was worth every penny!

This is a wonderful refrigerator! My wife and I searched online and in store displays for several months before deciding on this one. There are others with similar features that looked good, but we ruled them out after checking reviews from many different sources. This refrigerator is designed to make the best use of the space available, with shelves that are easily adjusted or removed and a large drawer that allows you to adjust its temperature independently from the rest. The bright LED lighting lets you see everything inside, no dark corners. The bottom freezer is set up to allow you to see and access everything easily, and it freezes things quickly! Some reviews said that this unit is noisy, but we find it to be pretty quiet, though the sounds it makes are sometimes quite different than our old refrigerator made. Weve had this unit for 2 months and so far we love it!

Ive had several problems with this refrigerator and its only 4 months old. The ice maker design is flawed and causes ice to jam in the tray. My vegetables froze in the lower bin despite the temperature setting being put on produce. Now I am getting error messages and am waiting for a service call. The freezer is not cooling properly and the defrost mechanism appears to have gone out.

Despite its size, the overall design makes it difficult to adequately store all of my groceries. There is inadequate space for taller items. Things tend to get buried in the back. I had a much easier time getting everything into my old side-by-side refrigerator despite it being smaller. The freezer has an annoying auto-close feature on the door. When loading groceries or looking for items, you must keep one hand on the door handle at all times to prevent it from closing. You cant use two hands to load or remove items.

This has been a great product thus far! There were some reviews about the noise level, but it seems very quiet. The ice size and storage box are smaller than some other products, however, the refresh rate is good. Ran out of ice once during a holiday gathering and will use the included freezer ice tray to stock up next time. It is easy to fill a glass with ice and water without pressing any buttons. The design makes sense to me, but we have had numerous people put a glass in the ice area and use the other hand to press the water button. Presto, instant floor wash!!

The material in darker colors easily shows lint and dust particles, but I dont think this would be as noticeable in lighter colors. Instead of buttons, the fabric at the neck opening (with two vertical peep holes) is secured with horizontal fabric slashes, which is a nice feature since buttons generally pop of and dont add much design interest.

I ordered four panels to use in our den in the moonlight blue color. Im attaching two pictures, the first of which is a close-up of the fabric, so you can see the weave. It is 100% polyester and has the appearance, from a distance anyway, of being a natural fabric or perhaps a blend. The curtains have a decent weight to them, so they hang nicely. The almost 3-inch hem helps in that regard, as well. Of course, everything in this house is nonstandard, it seems, so I had to hem ours that hang over by the dog door, as it would be impractical to have them pooled on the floor with the dogs running in and out all day long. (Behind the couch, I didnt bother to hem -- ha!# The moonlight blue looked somewhat gray-blue until I hung them, and then they took on an almost cornflower blue color, with the light behind them. The picture I took of the den is without a flash, taken around noon, facing west. They darken the room quite a bit #I had lace curtains up before#, so I decided to open the curtains behind the couch to let a little sunlight in. Ill probably switch these out in the summer for some aqua linen curtains to let in more light and have an airier feel, but I like these for winter. As for the construction/quality, they are decently made. There was about a 1/4 inch difference in length between the two I hemmed, which I took into account when hemming, although such a slight difference would probably not be noticeable even if they were hanging next to each other. I did notice a couple of flaws in the fabric as I was pressing the curtains #pulled threads#, but you dont notice that from a distance, of course. I got these on a good sale and probably would not feel they were worth the price at full price. #Im pretty picky, though.) Overall, Im happy with the curtains and the soothing blue appeals to me as I look into the den from my office here.

The F100 for its minimalist design and a bonus, it does not have a Chronograph or Tachymeter, two of the most useless functions that watch makers continually foist on the unsuspecting consumer.
Watch got dinged points for these two useless features.
The more I looked into watches and found what was available in form, function and features, this watch became less appealing to me. Its a nice watch but not for me.
This is an atomic watch but is geared to the US market because the prominent time zones are in the US. You can put it in manual mode for other time zones so I would not call it a true global watch.
There are only 6 atomic clocks in the world, 2 in Japan, so you need to live within signal range. In the southern hemisphere this would be nothing more than a regular quartz watch.

The OCW-G1000 has a chronograph but the bezel is low-key. Even Casio does not trumpet this feature in its marketing because its a useless feature. Buy a real stopwatch or use your smartphone, it will be more accurate.
When was the last time you saw someone whip out their wrist to use one of these functions. An alarm would more useful to the masses.

Casio has hybrid watches that can sync with atomic clocks and GPS satellites. More useful if you like to travel to countries in the southern hemisphere or are in places outside of the atomic clock signal range.
I can see GPS watches becoming more prominent than atomic clock watches for the simple fact that you can sync anywhere in the world so you always have accurate time.
Both atomic clocks and GPS has its drawbacks. Atomic Clocks can sync indoors but not everywhere. GPS can sync everywhere but not indoors.
There are other minor drawbacks so do your research to see if you can live with them because everybodys tolerance level is different.

I have an 8 year old Polar F1 that still works, but the transmitter belt has finally deteriorated (the plastic ends broke through). This FT1 is very similar, but the watch band looks suspect. I just received this, have used it two days and am concerned the gel-rubber band may not last. I will update over time. The one-button entries have a short learning curve and you wont regret the simplicity. After entering execute (start) you merely swipe your wrist past the chest sensor to toggle between heart rate, elapsed time and actual clock time. No buttons to push while working out! This is basic; no upload or tracking, but gives you right-now feedback of your workout intensity. The LARGE font is easy on these 60 YO eyes and preferable (to me) over the FT4/7 Polars watch face and font size. The band is the only reason to not give it 5 stars.

After less than 3 months of use, the transmitter was not sending a signal. I replaced the battery replaced and verified that the belt had a conductive connection to my skin. Still no signal. I was doubly irritated because my skin on either side of the POLAR transmitter battery holder was red and raw with a rash. Realized in reading about fixes that the belt had leaked the connective gel/fluid and caused the rash.

Its a good value, does the few things it does well. A good choice for a first heart rate monitor while youre deciding how much money to invest. The official battery replacement method is going to cost you as much as a whole new unit, so consider it disposable after a year or two of use. There are videos on replacing the battery yourself, but it may ruin the waterproofing and will definitely void the warranty.

In fact, this blanket pills worse than any other Ive ever tried. I feel as though these products are farces; big fat fakes suckering consumers to throw their money away on them. And then once their money has been tossed away, the trap is sprung and the blanket unravels.

Ive read previously that the secret to prevent these fleece blankets from pilling is to wash them in laundry bags and to hang them to dry. Unfortunately, the laundry bag idea doesnt quite work as there arent any bags made proportionally which would allow the blankets to balance in a washing machine with a center column. So the result is that either the washing machine must be overloaded or unbalanced causing it to walk across the room in an attempt to balance itself. Secondly, not everyone has the luxury of time and/or space to air dry blankets.

I believe the main issue which causes pilling and shedding is any projections from the washer and/or dryer that end up damaging the delicate texture of the blanket. Unfortunately for me, my dryer has large paddles which mix the laundry around and they appear to also be the culprit as far as creating horrifically damaged fleece blankets, leaving trails of hemorrhaged fibers in its wake. Its a nightmare and a blanket massacre.

This washer replaced a 15 year old washer.PROS - Great capacity, what was once a full load is now a 3/4 load! Washes well and has many cycles to choose from.

CONS- The soaking sink interferes with pouring detergent from a large container. You have to use a cup to be able to put the detergent in the holder. I opted to just pour into the tub on top of the clothes. The soaking sink also prevents you from seeing thru the glass top, making the glass almost useless. One significant annoyance is that the washer lid is not flat, but slightly curved, which I realized after several things slid off and fell on the floor. I am 5 foot 5 inches, and I need to really stretch to get the clothes out of the bottom of the washer. The manual is not well written and organized. With all the features of this washer, it is important to read thoroughly to get the best use out of the machine. Otherwise, you will probably end up using the same setting for everything. The manual does not recommend washing area rugs because sand could damage the machine. I bought this machine with the large capacity so that I could do small throw rugs, so this was a disappointment.

After using this for two days and ten loads of wash. You definitly need to run most loads on the highest spin setting to get the most water out of your cloths. My last washing machine a whirlpool spun the cloths to almost dry. I noticed that the bottom corners of the drum have no holes and this is where the cloths are the most wet. Also you might need a step stool to reach the bottom of the washer.

I really wanted this washer because it included the little dishpan/basin where I could soak or test colors of an item. Our laundry area does NOT have a sink, so without that little dishpan/basin I would have to do soaking/ testing in the kitchen and then drip across the house. The problem is since I am short (52) I cannot reach an item at the very bottom of the tub. PROBLEM SOLVED: I use long rubber coated (ends) tongs. I keep them on the shelf and always have them handy! I have been completely successful using the tongs to grab items too far from my reach. I am even learning to tong (grab) with my left hand (not dominant) to increase my brains abilities! (crossing mid-line !)

This is not a good machine for short people. I cant reach the bottom. Sometimes I need a step stool. Plus, my head hits the wash bin often trying to get clothes out. I love Samsung products and would exchange for another but I dont want to pay a restocking fee.

I first tried Formula X at a Sephora event in NYC--they had nail artists there doing mini manicures & nail art on people attending the event. I chose Dark Matter, the black shade. I have to say I was skeptical because I like OPI and so I didnt know what to expect from the new Formula X. Fast forward to NINE DAYS later, and my manicure is still mostly intact. I included pics below of day 1 and day 9 so you can see the difference. Most of my fingers arent even chipped at all--just a little bit on my left thumb & index finger. Even with those couple of little chips, I seriously cant believe how good this polish still looks after over a week of wear. No matter what brand of polish I use, or whether I do it myself or in the salon, my mani is usually toast in five days, tops. Not only did this stay on well, but it also still looks really glossy and fresh, not all battered and dingy like polish can get once youve had it on for a while. i didnt reapply topcoat either. Im really excited to try more colors of this polish--it really is amazing (and nice to know that if you want to do nail art at home, your hard work isnt just going to flake off in two days).

I was super excited when I first saw the Formula X polishes because theres such a huge wide range of colors. The first color that tried was Curiosity, which is a beautiful red shade, basically a pure red. For Christmas my brother picked me up Connectivity, which is really hard to explain, but its like a grayish bronze with small glittery metallic look. Its gorgeous and definitely more wearable than you may think. It stayed for 6 days, which is pretty impressive, but what I would expect for a glitter polish. My mom also gave me Fearless for Christmas, which is a pretty netural sage green. I love neutrals to death, and this is unlike any other color I own. The color looks really pretty on me, and I think it would look great on anyone for any season. But biggest complain with Formula though is the brush. I find the brush is just impossible to use and not get nail polish everywhere. I like to think Im good at painting my nails, but this brush is hard. Its streaky, too fat, either picks up not enough or too much polish, and too long to control. I also found Fearless to be kind of sticky and tacky, which was odd considering the packaging stops people from opening it in store. The cream colors only last for about 3-5 days, which is not really impressive, just standard in my opinion. However, because of the pretty shade range, I dont doubt that I will be purchasing more in the future.

I was very skeptical about the new Formula X polishes, but when I was shopping around I saw a nude color that I liked a lot. After thinking a bit I decided to go ahead and purchase it. The formula applied well, smooth and it was not overly streaky on the first coat (I think it streaked only on 2 of my nails) and no streaks on the second. It felt slightly thick, but it did not bother me - because I was able to work with it very well. Also one of the things I have noticed that even without the top coat polish was super shiny (omg it was awesome!).
In terms of wear - well, it lasted on me 3 days with no chipping at all !!! On the 4th day I noticed some tiny tip wear, and on the 5th day - I saw major chipping! Over all I was very impressed.
The Nude polish selection is great, so I would definitely recommend it!

I love nail polish, however, I find Im often disappointed with either the wear or the look of the polish. The opposite happened with the Formula X. I will say that I was irritated at first. Ill start with the cons:-Thin long brush (Im used to a wider brush)

I love Formula X. Ive tried other brands of nail polish and they all had issues... they chipped too soon, dried too slowly, or were only shiny for one day. Formula X blows all of those old nail polishes out of the water.

I love the color and the shine is fantastic. Its still wearing fabulously.
I have recommended this system to many people. I am hooked and recently purchased 4 more shades. Formula X is the best Ive tried.

I didnt give a full five stars because I already know Im probably going to burn the motor out since I make a smoothie everyday and Im already smelling burning motor after only two uses. I really just wanted to add some information in response to a previous review regarding pouring contents of the blender into the togo cups... The only blade assembly fits on ALL of the vessels provided with the blender. Theres no reason to pour your smoothie or whatever into the togo cups provided. You simply fill the togo cup with whatever youre blending and screw the blade assembly onto the togo cup and blend. Then you switch the blade assembly out for the togo lid and be on your way. Easy peasy, no funnels needed. However, I do wish there was some sort of closure on the togo cups lid so I dont have to worry about it tipping and spilling.

There really is only two flaws with this blender - first there is no real spout. So pouring into any container with an opening smaller than a Solo cup is difficult. The accompanying containers are like towers, so the opening at the top requires a funnel. If you are making a smoothie, the nature of what you are blending would make using a funnel pretty frustrating. So plan on pouring from the blender container into something fairly wide-mouthed, then into the to go containers. Now the 2nd flaw is the drinking spout on the containers. If you are placing a straw into it then no worries. If you are drinking directly from the spout, it requires more of a sucking action as there is no additional opening. Outside of these two design flaws, the blender is great for making smoothies or drinks. It makes quick work of ice or frozen fruit.
The Hamilton Beach blender meets every expectation and more. It easily blended an apple smoothie. I am very glad I bought it.

My Husband and I got a set of these rings for our 20th anniversary, while we still loved our original wedding rings, they no longer fit and re-sizing them wasnt an option. We wear these rings for our every day ring, keeping the black & gold rings in the same design for our special occasion rings. The dragon design shows up more on the black / gold set but it looks great on both of them. These look a bit more mainstream at first glance, standard Celtic knotwork - not everyone will know youre wearing dragons. A few notes - go to a JC Penny store to get sized for these rings and make sure they know youre getting a wide band ring and need to be sized with the thicker sizing ring set. We forgot and my husbands ring ended up being too small the first time around so we had to exchange it. Secondly, these rings cant be engraved by just anybody - they require laser engraving and some stores wont do that if you bought the ring elsewhere. We still plan to get ours engraved eventually to match our original rings but havent been able to do so yet. Last, the pictures dont really show it but there is a layer of clear resin over the dragon design which makes the ring surface flat. It looks good, but for durability reasons we take ours off before showers, swimming, washing dishes etc. Then again we always took our rings off before stuff like that anyway. All in all were very happy with our rings and everyone who has seen them loves them.

Mine is a hard room to humidify because it has forced heat, high 10-ft.ceilings, and covers nearly 500 sq. feet. My previous experience with this size humidifier has been poor. The Vornado, though better than some others, is no exception. During a typical New York winter day, leaving the unit on high fan and continuous max setting, results in humidity of 30-34%. Extreme cold and dry can make the level go down to 22% while snow and rain brings it to the 40 and 50% range. I like the fact that this unit is so quiet I can leave it on high all night and hear just a soothing hum. (The large humidifiers are so noisy I need to turn the fan speed down so they never reach a high enough level the rest of the day to come up to par.) Left on continuous high, this unit needs refills every 15-16 hours, NOT 24 as claimed. Since it has NO automatic shut-off, but will continue running on empty, you must check it continually. On the other hand, the small tank makes for easy carrying and refills, especially suitable for older and weaker people.

I have this in a room thats approximately 320 square feet. Its my office. I have some furniture in their and I knew by my humidity readings that it was low, and really low. This happens every year at this time. I have separate forced air unit for this space. It dries the air instantly. I also have a medium size Vordado heater, I keep it on low. I keep my Evap3 on low, my humidity is 35 to 37 percent. My point is everything is on low and its quiet. So for me, its perfect.

This thing just does not humidify! Ive had it running for the past month in one small room and...NO DIFFERENCE. Ive called Vornado headquarters and they have very nice customer service people. One sent me new filters. NO DIFFERENCE. They talk about their evaporative process, but truth be told, it just doesnt work. Its too late for me to return it. DONT MAKE THE SAME MISTAKE I DID!

My prior humidifier stopped evaporating air - although the motor was still running - overall it lasted about 10 years. I didnt realize that looking for another decent humidifier at a decent price was such a project! I wanted one with a digital display of humidity settings and current air humidity, but the decent ones cost a lot. I found reviews on this one and decided to give it a try. It was a good choice. The humidifier is nearly silent. Yes - you can sorta hear a hum, but overall its very quiet. I wish it would turn off once the water runs out, but it doesnt. It just keeps going, which is annoying. The mist is so microcosmic that it cannot be seen at all! Overall - this is a great humidifier for the price. It doesnt have all the bells and whistles, but it does the job in a great way!

I am happy with the purchase of the Vornado Humidifier. Its the perfect size for a smaller home and the multi settings are a great feature. I can choose more humidity at a faster pace or slower for even humidifying. The color I chose was black. My last one was white and the white may discolored over time.

I bought this to replace a smaller, single wick Vornado humidifier that was challenged by the increased size of rooms in a new house. And I wanted the minimum of maintenance. The cool mist units have the white dust issues unless you add a chemical to the water or a filter. The new (and expensive) evaporation/disk units also require an expensive additive and appear to be unwieldy to clean. The cost of replacement wicks is minimal. As to performance, with the double wick it has no problem humidifying a large great room. I like the humidity control which, judging from my humidity gage, is fairly accurate. It is a bit on the noisy side with the fan running on high. But I find the low setting, once the desired humidity level is reached, is pretty much sufficient to keep the humidity up and its virtually silent. The only thing I would change is the water tank. Having to remove it from the unit, and turn upside down to fill is less than perfect. Its a bit clumsy to handle and theres always a few drops of water that fall from the valve when removing and carrying the tank. Plus I dont trust the longevity of the cap seal. Id prefer a top fill, which could be done from a pitcher. All in all very satisfied. Looks are subjective. But in addition to the fine performance, I do like the looks of the unit.

The unit is doing the job. Humidity control for an attic space that needs to be maintained at 50% . Its a small room thats not over heated. The water needs to be replaced about every 36 hours. Not too bad. A small chore. My only complaint is that the fan motor is noisy. Not on high as one might expect but on low. It rattles. I guess the tolerance of the motor bearings isnt the tightest ? Pretty annoying if your attic is your office and you spend the day listening to this quiet little thing gently rattling in the corner. Apart from that ? Its all good. Maintains the humidity and doesnt look too bad doing it. So ? Vornado .

I have been using this unit for a month. I have purchased many such small humidifiers over the years and this is the best so far. I purchased a small Vornado unit last year and it has been great. So I decided to try this larger unit and found that it is very quiet relative to other fan-type units. We can run it on low in the bedroom and fan noise is not an issue at all. Last year we purchase a different manufacturers humidifier that was rated by Consumer Reports to have low noise. But the fan was too loud for use in a bedroom and it not that effective in output either. So that is why I rate this machine highly. I will likely buy another one of these for my daughters room.

We bought a new GE Profile Microwave Oven to replace a previous 10-year-old model which had developed arcing in its motor. I am concerned because the newer model has more plastic in its front, top and side construction than its predecessor, which had more stainless steel. And, when you close the door, it feels more lightweight and less solid as its predecessor. But, it seems to measure up, feature wise. There are a few more choices, such as Soften for butter. And, the fan will now go on automatically if too much heat is generated by the stove top beneath. Because of a design change re: the fan (the previous one opened up to release the air; this one has vents in the stationary top), it had to project a bit more forward in the cabinetry, which involved installing it with a sham behind it to push it forward more. There is a monogram on the oven that is not flush, but sticks out. I think that will be a real grease catcher; I wish it had been printed on the panel, instead, like the previous model.

No need to compromise on this Microwave. I had purchased a Maytag a little over a year ago that look good because it was stainless steel on the inside and outside, but it did not perform well at all. Additionally, it started breaking down within a week of the warranty expiring. The vent fan on the Maytag would blow the flames from the gas stove everywhere making it virtually impossible to cook things while having the vent on. It also did not heat the plates evenly.

This GE Microwave has since solved all of the problems that I have had with the Maytag. It not only heats everything evenly, but even heats faster. The vent on full blast effectively removes steams from food being cooked on the stove without disturbing how evenly the flames hit the pots. This microwave is amazing. I hope it proves to be reliable as time goes on though.

It is perhaps the BEST washing machine Ive ever used in the past 30 years and Ive owned many high-end appliances. I couldnt rate my new laundry appliances other than PERFECT. Dont hesitate if youre on the fence.

Unfortunately the Energy Star people take manufacturers word for it that the appliances they certify perform their function according to expectations.  We bought this as a match to the dryer, which works OK. Big mistake. Zero stars.

The machine gets the clothes wet with soapy water and basically tosses them listlessly back and forth in the drum. The truth about this machine is that you must use the pre-wash feature, use the hottest cycle, and add an extra rinse/s in order to get anything clean. For towels, I run an extra speed wash with household vinegar.

This machine takes about 2-3 hours per load--if you have a large family, you will be running it nonstop. It requires additional maintenance every month. If you dont wipe out the seal and leave the door open, you will have a stinky mold problem. Lastly, if you have to run every load twice in boiling water, and replace the machine every five years (now average for durable goods), thats not reallyan energy savings, is it?
The only thing i dont like is after you wash, you have to wipe down the door or leave the door open so it dries out from the inside so it doesnt leave a foul odor.

Being European I had used front loaders all my life and was disappointed with the top loaders in USA since the wash quality is not the same.This new LG is using even less water than the previous one and needs even less detergent, generally 1/4 of the amount the detergent container instructs. Since the clothes get more friction than in top loaders the results are much cleaner with less detergent. I also try to be as green as possible and living in hot Texas consider drying clothes outside much smarter choice than using dryer that just ends up heating the air I already have to cool down with air-conditioning. But I like to use hot water for towels and bed linens and find the steam cycle perfect for that.I am very allergic to detergents and until I found out how little detergent I need I ended using extra rinse and spin option. The people that complain about the soap in rinse cycle just use too much soap and need to use only a fraction of the amount they used with top loaders and try different cycle options to find out what works for them.I also like the custom setting option for my most used loads.My laundry is sparkling white and fresh smelling.

This boot has alot going for it:-Nice details like the broguing and toe medallion allow it to be worn business casual, but still has the ruggedness and comfort of a boot so it doesnt look or feel at all out of place with jeans.-Full grain leather, and it is not at all cheap feeling. Supple and soft and plenty flexible- not plasticky or stiff. This is the kind of leather you can make last for a long time with a little conditioner, cream, and wax.-Boot construction is great. Sturdy sole and Ive been wearing the heck out of them for weeks now and they are doing great. Super comfortable and I get compliments on them all the time.-Price: You will not find another boot in this price range that even sniffs this quality. Youd have to spend about three times as much usually. Amazing value here.

It isnt perfect, of course.-The sole is not welted, so when the sole goes so does the boot. No matter, it should last for years even with heavy use. But a great leather boot/shoe will develop a unique appearance over time that you lose when you cant resole them.-Also, the closure at the top of the boot is a little off. The two sides of the vamp overlap after being laced up. It isnt visible with pants obviously, but the fit could be a bit better around the ankle (something to improve on next year?).-Would also be nice if there were more colors available. The cognac looks awesome, but I wouldnt mind seeing a more burgundy/cordovan shade made available to compliment the brown/black options currently.
Summary: If you need a nice pair of boots that can go casual or business casual, youd be silly to pass these up. Great job, JCP!

I had read all the reviews about this cushion, and was excited to get my order, which came very quickly! The cushions were great quality and the perfect natural color. However, there was an unusual issue that I hadnt seen addressed by anyone else. The back of my kitchen chairs have an open back wooden look, with a large X design, and the back of the chairs face into the living room. You end up seeing the rubber gripper portion of the chair cushion, which is an olive green color with bright green gripper strips, ie it clashes with the beautiful natural color of the cushion (and I have no olive green or bright green in my rooms). Unfortunately your eye gets drawn right to that darker clashing portion of the cushion, so I had reluctantly had to return them. If you have chairs with a closed back, I would definitely recommend you buy these- they are great quality cushion, especially for the price!

As far as color goes, I can only comment on Pink Lady, but its a beautiful, youthful, bright pink that is feminine and pretty without being obnoxious. I love the sheerness of the color, too. Its translucent enough that if you were applying it in a hurry and didnt have a perfect line, no one would know the difference. But the color is saturated enough that its definitely noticeable. This product is long-lasting in that it doesnt feel like it kisses off immediately on your coffee mug, or that it evaporates from your lips after 30 minutes. The tingling is nice, refreshing, and does feel like its plumping up my pout a bit. Ive never owned a go-to gloss (because I usually hate glosses!) but this is it for me now. Love, love, love, love.

I bought this HE washer after my old one died. This washer has a big barrel and should be able to washer a lot of clothes in one load. We tried to do this. The clothes come out and most of them are not even wet. and some a dripping wet, in the same load. I now only put a third of a load on at a time. What is the point of having a large barrel, when you have to only put in 1/3 of a load and wash it three times. My cloths come out smelly and dirty! I have to rewash everything! This is the worst washer I have ever had. Instead of making your washer so WATER friendly. Make them actually work! Also the cycles are extra long an hour and a half for heavy duty, but even on the longest cycle, with hot water and on the heavy duty AND heavy soil cycles the clothes are not washed well. If I have to wash less cloths two and three cloths times, how is that being water, energy and time efficient? Also the self clean cycle is 4 hours. The time is not mentioned anywhere in the manuel. Make sure you do self clean over night, not during a busy wash day!!

This washing machine is easy to use and it does a great job washing clothes and other fabrics. BUT it has a flaw that is very annoying. Whenever it goes into the spin cycle it vibrates so much that it causes the washer to move (it walks). It walks faster than my 97 year old grandmother. We bought it from an authorized Samsung reseller and paid for installation. The reseller had their installation expert come over twice to try to fix it. He made sure that it was level and inspected it thoroughly. The expert suggested placing rubber around the washers stands to secure it. That is unacceptable but what can we do? We placed rubber molding around each stand and it does reduce the amount of walking, but I dont think thats acceptable, considering the washers high cost.

Using Tide/Kirkland HE detergents, softener and bounce for drying my clothes, but it still smells bad like washing clothes with water only and let it sit in the washer for a couple days before drying it.

I understand its high efficiency in using less water and detergents, but if it does not make our clothes smell good like the washer without HE, then its definitely not good to spend more money for it.

Regardless how much detergents I used or the clothes level in the basket or washing modes, I have never seen water in the basket except while doing Sanitary/Self Clean modes while the non-HE washer always has about half of the basket. Sometimes, some of the clothes barely gets wet after washing and sometimes the clothe had detergent stains on it and I had to put it in a bucket of water to hand-wash it. I also see 0% detergent foams in the basket while the none HE washer has tones of foams depending how much detergents you use.
I did Sanitary/Self Clean modes with bleach/vinegar every month and still not resolve the issue.
Im a very disappointed customer!

After another load finished the drum was stopped, but the light was on when I went to get my load of sheets and everything was dried. Another thing is the size. The dryer has a sensor to check the cloths to ensure they don’t over dry – and you need to be sure the clothes you have in the load are all the same type of fabric, for instance an old dress shirt with jeans may trigger the dryer to adjust the drying time - as it does dry quicker, and the jeans will still be damp. Ive worn a variety of brands and styles of Long Leg High Waist Panty Girdles (LLHWPGs) for about 20 years now, but the Cortland 5033 is by far the best one ever! While not quite as firm as the Rago 6210, the Cortland 5033 provides considerably more shaping and control than similar products from Flexees, Maidenform, and the like. The material is silky smooth, is very breathable, and is far more comfortable than the Rago 6210. The waistband doesnt roll down, the legs dont ride up, and the inner seams are sewn flat and are imperceptible. To top it off, the styling, with its sheer front panel, is fantastic.

While most reviews that Ive read state that this item runs true to size, I believe it runs slightly larger. I initially bought this item according to the Cortland size chart and my actual measurements, but found that it only provided moderate control and that I could remove it relatively easily without unzipping/unhooking the waist opening. I then bought the next smaller size and attained the level of firmness to be expected of a maximum control girdle. I am now totally satisfied with this product, and I highly recommend it to anyone searching for the best combination of control, comfort, and style.

I purchased this in R510. In the Original Foundation, Im Golden Dark for either the powder or the matte foundation. In the READY, Golden Dark is too light and Im GUESSING Im Warm Deep in the Winter since its not very warm even those the sun may be out and Golden Deep in the Summer when Im more exposed to heat and the sun has a greater impact on making me darker which doesnt take much; 10-15 minutes in the sun during the summer time and Im all the way tan. So I cant really tell if Warm Deep or Golden Deep is the one for me. I couldnt really tell the difference. I have a full sized Warm Deep and then the Golden Deep in this kit. I could be between colors, Im not sure. If all else fails, I know that Golden Dark in the original powder has been good all year round so I could just stick to that after a little trail and error I guess lol. I like this kit because you can get it on and get out the door in no time. I like the foundation of course, the different color veil versus the original and tinted is GREAT because not everyone can wear just two colors of veil, the bronzer I wish was The Deep End. The High Dive bronzer in this kit matches my skin tone...I could use it for a powder concealer I guess just under my eyes just in case I were to run out of the concealer....which leads me to the next item in the kit. The concealer is in Dark 2 which is lighter than Deep 2. I know this sounds weird, but I know concealer is mean to conceal dark circles and when light is added to it, that creates the illusion of making the face look more lifted up. But if the concealer is too light, you end up really having to blend your foundation over it so that you face has a nice smooth look to it. Nothing is worse than having your concealed areas more obvious with the wrong concealer shade. Im not saying I cant make Dark 2 work, I just have to be careful not to use too much. I have Deep 2 concealer and it blends great into my skin whether Im using my finger or using a brush to blend it (I cant find the READY concealer in the product suggestions, but look up READY concealer and you should be able to find it). The Luminizer of course always does its job. You apply that to the bridge of the nose, tips of your cheekbones, a tad big on the forehead and I even put a small amount just under my bottom lip. I even dust a little over my eyelids after applying my eye shadow. The brushes are small, yes. But this is a safe way to go if youre afraid that you may put on too much. If you tap into the foundation maybe 2-3 times, you can start applying to the face in long, downward/sideways motions if youre using the angled precision brush. If you use the tapered rounded brush, you want to tap it into the foundation 2-3 times as well but then use a buffing motion just like you would if you were using the loose powder, just after the swirl, tap step. I like the fact that this is in a keepsake makeup clutch. Theres also a place for a larger brush if you would like to really pick up the speed of applying your makeup. I like to put either my Multi-Tasking Brush in the brush slot or my Flawless Face Brush in it. Both would do VERY well. Plus this clutch has a mirror so that takes all the guess work out of finding a mirror to check yourself out unless you wanted a small one to fit comfortably into your purse. If youre into large purses, this would fit very well in it. For a smaller purse, not so much unless you have just your wallet in it. This isnt a HUGE makeup kit, but its the right size. I like how you have enough of each product in the kit. I thought it would be tiny because online, looks can be deceiving. But I was shocked, in a good way, that this turned out to be a worthy buy, even though the bronzer and concealer wasnt really a hit (for MY skin tone). The price is great, slightly cheaper than what stores sell it for and besides....if you were to pay for each item in this kit separately, it gets expensive very fast. Thanks Bare Minerals for making a go-to kit thats fast for ladies to get to without having to pick through a makeup bag and guess whats in it. Its all laid out and labeled for us ladies who need it! Also, the big brush that you see in my picture, its my own Flawless Face Brush and does not come in the kit so I wanted to be sure you all know that. I took a pic of it over the foundation so you can see how much product you get in comparison to the size of the bristles in my brush. The little brushes I put in my hand so you can get an idea of the size of those as well. Hope this review helps!

It senses how much water it needs for the load. Basically, you throw a bunch of stuff in it, put in the suds, and tell it to GO. It knows what it needs to do with only that much input. Awesome. It is a little tall, so my youngest has trouble getting the clothes a the bottom out, but most adults wouldnt have any issues.

I bought the LG washer about a year and a half ago. It worked well for about a year. The past few months I have been having problems with it getting off balance. I have to pull the clothes out and put them back in - sometimes several times to get a load done. In addition, I have been having problems with the powder detergent leaving white spots/streaks on my colored clothes, therefore, I have to either rewash or re-rinse. For a washer to cost SOOOO much, you would think you could get a few good years out of it. The dryer that sets beside this deluxe washer is the only one Ive EVER owned. Purchased in 1980 and works like a CHARM. NO, I will NOT be upgrading my dryer! WHY? The new appliances will NOT hold up. VERY disappointed!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I chose this washer because so many family members switched to front loaders and were buying new machines within 5 to 7 years. I have kids that loved to overload my heavy duty Whirlpool which always caused the fingers on the agitator to break. Even though I had 19 years with that machine I wanted to try something without a agitator so I read tons of reviews on washing machines. Im a guy so I just want to throw mixed laundry in, add laundry detergent and let the machine do its thing. My family told me they had to watch their front loaders for unbalanced loads so that was another reason I didnt want one. Their were some reviews that said top loaders also had that issue, but I havent seen many complaints so I thought Id give this Huge Powerful LG a try. The machine is compact for the Huge loads it can handle. I wanted something big enough so I wouldnt have to take my King size comforter or adult sleeping bags to the local Laundromat. This machine has no problem fitting large items in it. I like the front control panel, I dont have to reach over the washer to select my settings they are easy to read right in front of me. The tub is deep, just as deep as a front loader but it seems deeper to a short person reaching in, so my suggestion to the shorter folks is to get a step stool. Im 5 10 and can just reach the bottom to get small items such as socks out. Some reviews say without an agitator the clothes dont get clean enough. That was my worry before I saw how nice my clothes and towels came out of this machine! It doesnt look like their is much water in the tub during the cycle, but you have water/detergent spraying from the top at times and the jets spraying from the bottom which you dont see. The bottom line is my laundry smells cleaner than my agitator model and I can feel how much more fluffy my towels are! I have only used the bulk setting for bedding, normal wash with fabric softener, and the turbo wash cycle and have had no issues what so ever. As far as noise and vibration of the machine, yes their is vibration that is well controlled and as far as noise this puppy runs up to 1100 rpm! So yes I hear it upstairs through my hollow basement door. It is noticeable, but only when it is in high spin cycle and it is not that bad. When I pull my laundry out it is darn near dry already! I love this machine! The only reason why I didnt rate it 5 stars is because this is my first LG appliance and I havent seen how durable their products are for the long run. Ive seen my parents Whirlpool washer/dryer set go for the 18 years I lived at home and then my Whirlpool set last for 19 years. So far the technology LG has with this machine is great, now to see if it stands up to the test of time...

LOVE THIS AS MUCH AS THE DRYER! REALLY APPRECIATE THE ALLERGEN CONTROL CYCLE AS I AM ALLERGIC TO DUST MITES. ESPECIALLY LIKE THE FACT THAT I DONT HAVE TO GUESS HOW MUCH WATER ILL USE, SINCE IT DOES T FOR ME!

Ive owned the Roomba 650 previously. I bought the 860 for my mother as I had a good experience with the 650. The 860 is much better, from a maintenance stance, as there are no brushes to clean. This was particularly annoying considering there were a lot of long hairs all over the place, our household was comprised of a dog and two women. I also considered the Neato 75D. The reason why I chose the 860 over the Neato was due to the fact that I prefer the random cleaning method... Why? I plan on running my Roomba everyday therefore I feel a random cleaning method will clean my floors better over a long period of time. Think about it, this Roomba will approach the floor/carpet from all sorts of angles v. the neato which will only approach the floor from one angle. One concern many people had with the Roomba was that by using its random algorithm, it may miss spots every so often. However, over multiple cleaning cycles, Im sure those spots would get cleaned.

Gone are my days of back-taxing lugging/tugging of long central vac hoses & carpet-cleaning uprights for my hard wood & area (even throw) rugs. Ive become a sucker for a button marked Clean. I move furniture for deep cleaning but, more often, its a kitchen garbage can here & dishes for two dogs there. While its shape avoids corners, a simple dust mop is the solution. The receptacle could be bigger but its never an issue even with only once-daily use. If / when the Full icon lights, I press Clean to stop so it can be emptied, then Clean again to resume. Dont let the price dissuade you. Its comparable to those that tout high-efficiency & those still require your active participation.

Our 50 year old Sunbeam mixer (handed down from Mom) decided enough is enough and stopped working. We replaced it with a new Sunbeam since we received such great service from the old one. The new Heritage Stand Mixer by Sunbeam® is designed nicely, has great speed features which allow the motor to start slow and gradually increase in power so your contents do not fly out all over the place (a really nice feature in my opinion). Unfortunately the frame itself is not near as sturdy as the old one and when heavy dough is processing, the whole mixer wobbles and shudders. The motor is definitely powerful and plows through pizza dough like butter but again, the frame is not up to par with the motors capacity. The stainless steel dough hooks are so massive and thick, I would expect them to last a lifetime. Beaters are heavy with no center stem so batters dont get caught in center. There is no wire whisk with this unit. If your every day mixing needs consist of of cakes, batters, soups with an occasional pizza/bread dough in between, this mixer will suit your needs fine. If youre looking for a bread/pizza dough mixer to be used on a regular basis with those heavier doughs, you will want to go for a sturdier framed unit .

I see from reading the reviews that some have a problem with fading, especially the black. I buy a large bottle of white distilled vinegar and use half in an 8 quart pot filling the rest (about half) of the way with cold water. Put in one pair of black (or any color) jeans and let it sit for several hours. Add more cold water if needed to completely cover the jeans. I stir them, with my hands of course to get all the fabric, do this often. This seems to set the color longer. I then spin it out in the washer and hang to dry. After they are dried, you can wash and rinse in cold water. I always hang my jeans to dry. I hope this helps.

Ok, so this is a saga..bear with me. It started in September when I ordered the old Keurig system, because I had heard too many negatives about the 2.0. Well, the old one, a K45, didnt work well at all. I complained and Keurig sent the K2.0 350 as a replacement. No better! They sent out a K2.0 300. It was the same. Took way over 2 minutes to brew a cup. In the meantime, as I am complaining to family and friends about the lengthy brew time, they informed me, three of them, that the K2.0 200 worked like a charm and delivered coffee quickly! As I called again about the horrible performance of the K2.0 300, Keurig graciously offered to upgrade to the more expensive model. I immediately said No, just send me the cheaper one, the K2.0 200, because I know this one has a good track record. This model works the best! Believe me!!! Fast brewing (50 seconds), hot, and you can use your own coffee pod to brew your own brand without using the expensive Kcups, if that is what you want to do!! It took me 4 Keurigs to finally get one that delivers. This one is finally a keeper!!!

Received this product as a gift. After years of using my old Keurig Mini , I was excited to get the new 2.0. Bottom line, I went back to using my old keurig mini after about 2 weeks. Nothing I do removes the burnt plastic taste from my coffee. I have soaked all removable parts (water reservoir, k-cup holder, etc) in white vineagar over night, spent an hour running white vinegar and water cleanses through the machine, and I even washed all the removable parts in the dishwasher (something youre not supposed to do but it was my last resort). Nothing I do removes the plastic taste and smell. Everything I try to brew is undrinkable. Reading the reviews from other 2.0 owners, I see I am not the only one drinking coffee that tastes like a burnt barbie doll. I have been a loyal customer for years, and even recruited my parents to the brand (my mom owns a coffee shop so this was quiet a feat), but I am now fearful of the plastic being used in the new 2.0 brewers. This will probably be the last Keurig product I use.

And since I can only make a 10oz cup, why do I have to put so much water into the water reservoir? Lastly, whats the deal with the filter that is in the package, but mentioned no where in the instructions? So weird and incomplete. My coffee was good, but for the money, I want a product that was advertised and as good as the older models Ive used in the past at work. Im taking my K200 back.

even though some pods are labeled for use. such as Meijer brand. machine clogs up and coffee grounds go all over machine inside. went through 3 machines in 3 weeks. still not right. tech support even said that our filtered water was too clean. we replaced a 10+year old bun coffee maker that still works. thought this would be more convenient. we like the variety of pods. just wish that if it says keurig brewed on package. it would work properly.

1. buff and smooth the nail surface (very useful fundamental step which may save you money on ridge filler purchases),2. do not put on bast coat,3. 1-coat for most opaque colors, 2nd coat only for sheer colors. The new Heritage Stand Mixer by Sunbeam® is designed nicely, has great speed features which allow the motor to start slow and gradually increase in power so your contents do not fly out all over the place (a really nice feature in my opinion). Unfortunately the frame itself is not near as sturdy as the old one and when heavy dough is processing, the whole mixer wobbles and shudders. The motor is definitely powerful and plows through pizza dough like butter but again, the frame is not up to par with the motors capacity. The stainless steel dough hooks are so massive and thick, I would expect them to last a lifetime. Beaters are heavy with no center stem so batters dont get caught in center. There is no wire whisk with this unit. If your every day mixing needs consist of of cakes, batters, soups with an occasional pizza/bread dough in between, this mixer will suit your needs fine. If youre looking for a bread/pizza dough mixer to be used on a regular basis with those heavier doughs, you will want to go for a sturdier framed unit .

I didnt give a full five stars because I already know Im probably going to burn the motor out since I make a smoothie everyday and Im already smelling burning motor after only two uses. I really just wanted to add some information in response to a previous review regarding pouring contents of the blender into the togo cups... The only blade assembly fits on ALL of the vessels provided with the blender. Theres no reason to pour your smoothie or whatever into the togo cups provided. You simply fill the togo cup with whatever youre blending and screw the blade assembly onto the togo cup and blend. Then you switch the blade assembly out for the togo lid and be on your way. Easy peasy, no funnels needed. However, I do wish there was some sort of closure on the togo cups lid so I dont have to worry about it tipping and spilling.

There really is only two flaws with this blender - first there is no real spout. So pouring into any container with an opening smaller than a Solo cup is difficult. The accompanying containers are like towers, so the opening at the top requires a funnel. If you are making a smoothie, the nature of what you are blending would make using a funnel pretty frustrating. So plan on pouring from the blender container into something fairly wide-mouthed, then into the to go containers. Now the 2nd flaw is the drinking spout on the containers. If you are placing a straw into it then no worries. If you are drinking directly from the spout, it requires more of a sucking action as there is no additional opening. Outside of these two design flaws, the blender is great for making smoothies or drinks. It makes quick work of ice or frozen fruit.

You guys arent getting the concept of this.. Its not a BB cream that gives you coverage as in foundation! It helps brighten the skin, anti aging, and can use under makeup or over night to wake up with bright and nice skin!

The description for this product says no need for cleansing. I have trouble getting my mind around the idea of sleeping in makeup. I can count the number of times Ive done it on one hand, and I still shudder remembering the skin breakouts the following day. BB Night is a clear gel with white pigment beads that pop when you blend the gel into your skin. The texture is more watery than most gels. Its like a sheer stain for lips, only its for the face. Its not the right color for daywear, for me. Im NC35/37 and the color almost emphasizes, rather than masks, my discolorations. This doesnt really provide any coverage, so the discolorations go from brown to gray. (Not a good look). If you need to add tint to your skin without coverage, this is great stuff. The really, really good thing about this, is it does NOT get all over bedsheets...no matter how much you, ahem, move around. (I tested this thoroughly for the sake of science). I really like that this has Niacinamide, so, hopefully regular use will get rid of discolorations!

I honestly have no idea what the point of this product is. I received a sample with my Clarisonic and thought Id give it a try. It dried up pretty quickly so it wasnt very blendable. Overnight, this product made me break out. Trashed sample.

There seems to be confusion on what this is...This Night BB (in my opinion) is a niche product, as in I use it for specific instances. Here is why/when I use it:- For a casual night out when I dont want to bother with makeup when there is a possibility I will be too lazy to wash my face (lets be real here)- For when I washed up at night, but may or may not have to go out at some point-When I feel like my skin needs a breather from heavier makeup or even other BB creams- At my boyfriends house at night (ya know?)I like it because after I wash up and put this on, it doesnt feel like Im clogging pore. Its even lighter than a BB cream but still evens out my skin and gives me a healthy looking glow. Unlike other reviewers, I havent found it to be drying.I dont use it for everyday-wear but I like having it handy for those specific instances. The only reason I give 4/5 is bc sometimes the white beads leave little flecks. Make sure to blend it in for it to take full effect!So, maybe its not for you. But if you can relate to any of the above then I would really recommend it!

Load size is sensed by the machine which adds water accordingly. The steam feature is very useful for enhancing cleaning results with many cycles. Multiple water temperatures, soil level selections, stain removal cycles, multiple spin speeds & number of rinse selections further enable personally customized cycles which can be stored by the machine. A nice convenience & could enable children/seniors to wash clothes without having to push more than one button. Multiple water temperatures, soil level selections, stain removal cycles, multiple spin speeds & number of rinse selections further enable personally customized cycles which can be stored by the machine. A nice convenience & could enable children/seniors to wash clothes without having to push more than one button. The delay wash feature is a personal favorite & Im looking forward to using the overnight dry cycle. Unlike many front load machines, it has both pre-soak & pre-wash cycles. Having a lighted drum is an unexpected, but welcome feature as is the integrated pedestal which really does provide the right height. Anything taller wouldnt have fit in my space & anything lower would have caused difficulty for me.

I only used it 3 times, but so far so good; it washes clothes really well, the machine itself looks great and its easy to use. All the dials and buttons look intimidating at first, but its actually user friendly, quiet and simply awesome!
It is big :) It has failed in the first week due to basic door sensor issue. GE service came in 1 week. Besides that, i like the height and the sound.
I purchased the machine about six months ago, I am please wit the performance and chooses of cycles that it comes with.
We purchased this a month ago and we love it. We love the speed wash and how fast the dryer drys!

Ive had this washer for less than 2 months. From the beginning it always slams back and forth when getting ready to spin like its out of balance but does stop once its spinning. Still highly annoying to hear. Now in the past week it has started to leak water out the front left of the machine leaving puddles on my floor. This is my 3rd ge machine and all have been junk. Very disappointed.
The half-pedestal feature of this unit makes it easy for getting loads into the machine. Since its part of the unit, there isnt a risk of it getting wobbly or otherwise disconnecting from the base.

There were a few features beyond the pedestal that made this unit a perfect pick for us, the overnight tumble-dry and the excellent internal lighting are at the top of that list. Also, the ability for this unit to get the water out of the cloths on a normal cycle is much better than our previous units. For most cloths, we can simply hang-dry them for a couple hours and they are done.

This unit replaces our second washer from another top-rated vendor in less than 10 years, and we are hoping that we get the same longevity from this GE unit as we did on machines prior to switching manufacturers.
Our only complaint so far is the dispenser drawer seems to accumulate water and its a little awkward to clean. Honestly, if we can get 5+ years out of this unit we will be ecstatic.
I love this front loader - its quiet, sophisticated and efficient. The price is right as well. We are very happy with our purchase!
The machine is beautiful. It does a lot of laundry, and appears to be very efficient. The washer though has required me to have the service folks here on 3 different occasions.

The machine will struggle to pump out water from large loads like sheets, towels, rugs & blankets. The technician said the system is detecting that it cant drain, but it wont finish the load w/o draining. So in order to finish the load, it has to add more water!

This appeared to be fixed by the last visit from the technician who replaced the motherboard, but unfortunately it happened again so I am back in troubleshooting mode. I do want to return it, especially after 4 months of owning it, so I will continue to call the technician until the issue can no longer be rectified.

I like the clear cover and basket light. Controls are easy to use and figure out. Its a really nice design.

I bought the washer and dryer pair. They are great! They are attractive in appearance. The lid is glass, so you can look in to see your clothes as they wash. The matching Dryer has a glass door-great. The washer is quiet, and it has many useful washing cycles to choose from. There is a light in both the washer and dryer. That is a very useful feature. The combination of the washer and dryer features has made doing laundry an easy task. They have made a dreaded chore kind of like a walk in the park.

I love using my new washer & dryer, they not only look great, but are so easy to use with so many options! The only negative that I have noticed is that the clothes are wrung out so well in order to dry quickly in the dryer, that they come out of the washer quite wrinkled. But, the wrinkles come out in the dryer and dry incredibly quick, so its wonderful!

After a lot of shopping around, this was my choice to replace a well known washer brand (a machine that had to literally be rebuilt from the ground up, and finally died after 8 years.) The new GE machine is fantastic. Wonderful size, more than enough room for doing large loads like comforters. Great washing action. Cleans everything perfectly. Lots of settings and extra features/settings if you take the time to learn the machine. Considering the compatible dryer to use the communications feature.
Thought too big, but have now really enjoyed the extra large drum size! I can wash just about anything!!!!
Really love the clear lid, large tub and easy controls.

You can do huge loads with this washer-so big-I need a bigger dryer to handle the load size. The spin cycle rings out nearly every drop of water, but the downside to that is that cloths get mangled and must be unwound before putting them in the dryer. Also, if you are shorter than 54, the tub is too big to be able to get items out of the bottom. The washer also walks across the room on the spin cycle-and Ive had it leveled 3 times in 6 months!
I am overall pleased. The dryer makes an occasional noise like a chain rattling, but it does not affect its performance.

The washing machine does not clean the clothes at all, but it is very quiet. The washer continues to go through the cycle even though the door is open. This washer fills with water and then starts going through the cycles even with the top open, before I return with my laundry. Therefore, it does not allow me to multitask. Now I have to get my laundry, start the washer and WAIT there until it fills with water, quickly put my detergent and laundry in. I hate this GE washer.

I have been so far very satisfied with this product. It is a little more technical than what I thought at purchase; but, so far I am well pleased. The only thing that I could say is a negative is the ice dispenser is a little too forceful.

Downloaded the PDF instruction manual to my iPad, which I find more convenient than using the paper manual.

I bought 2 at the same time, #10 (red) and #4 (teal). The teal one is amazing: opaque, long lasting, great for hooded lids (no transfer!). The red one though is a major fail. I bought 5 (turquoise), 8 (electric purple) and 9 (fuchsia) and my absolute favorite color of the 3 was the turquoise but no matter how much I loved the color, it turned out to be the only one that didnt stay on when it got wet AND it stained my eyelid. I even swatched all 3 of them on my hand and dabbed at it with water and the turquoise was the only one that faded and left a blue stain on my hand. (see pictures below)

However, the purple (8) and pink (9) stays on great (even through a shower) and there wasnt any staining after removing it. I find the only time it starts flaking is when you rub the product really hard when its wet but other than that, I love these!
I always do my research before buying product and i have to say that its totally worth it.
I got this liner in #8 (Iridescent Electric Purple) - because i have green eyes.
The applicator brush is slightly small and stiff, but you can get used to it. Color payoff is amazing - this purple color is fairly bright and has some bluish/purple/pink micro-glitter in it.

Many people complained about flaking - and i have to say i had the same issue the first time i used it .But i think that i did not shake the bottle and thats why flaking occurred. Even if i was not impressed after the first use, i decided give it few more tries - and im glad i did. I made sure i shook the bottle well and i applied only 2 layers - and everything was just alright and perfect (no flaking) !!!
The liner stays on eyes all day without flaking or smudging, even if i go swimming or its 100 degrees outside. And it’s pretty easy to remove - just with warm water and any makeup remover!!
In the swatch below you can see the duochrome color on the brush, and the heart” swatched with only one layer (with 2 layers color will look closer to the one on the applicator).

It made a VERY small batch, one in which you had to be on your guard while eating in order to maintain all of your teeth.Second the machine itself: Even though we used the measuring cups for the oil and popcorn, the machine clogged up while popping and we had to stop it and clean out the popper during the popping process.Also, it was very crowded inside the machine itself just to access the inner kettle in order to get the oil and the kernals loaded without spilling all over.It was also tricky to remove the popcorn from the machine without grabbing each handful. Cleanup: difficult, as there is no pan or anything to remove, you just have to go in and remove all the old maids, etc. by hand and then wipe down with a rag.We tried four batches, but all four were lousy.I would not recommend this product unless you just want it for display. Its very cute!

I have been wanting one of these for so long - I had the extra 20% off coupon so i bought it. Got it home, bought popcorn and oil and unboxed it. My kids were so excited. It turned and turned and nothing. We shut it off, turned it back on and finally we could hear the sizzle and pop pop - more kernels shot out then popped corn. Kids got their popcorn, needed to make 2 batches for 3 kids (18, 11, 9 yr). Popcorn was a little chewy - but expected -not like air popped. It was easy clean up - while wiping down the plastic walls, there were these melted spots where the the hot kernels hit the walls. I only could envision it after 5 more uses... a popcorn popper with chicken pox. It went back. Great idea - I would have paid a little more for glass walls.

I got this as a gift for my boyfriend for xmas! He loves popcorn! It was very easy to put together and really easy to use. 2 things I would want to mention is that there are little vent slits on both sides to let the heat out. The kernels and little pieces of popcorn shoot out of these slits while its popping. Which I dont really mind, I just pick them up afterwards. The second and biggest issue I have is that its kind of hard to clean. The metal part that pops the kernels does come out but getting inside it to clean it is complicated, the unit itself, and the metal part. It makes you not want to use it as much knowing your going to have to spend so much time cleaning it. All in all he loved it so it was worth it!

I was very excited to get this popcorn popper!!! See My friend has the larger model (the one with the wheels) and i just loved the popcorn from her machine!!! the popcorn was warm and YUMMY!!! I was very bummed when I made the first batch most of the kernals did not pop-you need to cook like 2 or 3 batches then recook the unpopped kernals. also the plastic walls cracked and blistered. After 3 weeks I returned it and ordered the larger one for 50.00 more. ALSO get the 1 year service contract!!!!

Bought this for my popcorn loving husband . It has been used at least 3 or more times a week for the last 9 months. He has mastered the technique of corn popping. We have tried all brands of corn and none are any better than the next. Kernels left over are vacuum out with a shop vac, then wiped out; a 2 minute job. Buying one for my sons family for Christmas. One other comment the handle was complicated, the rule of righty tighty does not apply it is the opposite (go left or counter clockwise).

I bought this popcorn maker based on the previous reviews. Boy was I 100% wrong - first this popcorn maker does not come with any popcorn - at leastt they should throw in 1 bag to say thanks!! It says it comes with a heating lamp - it is just a light bulb and it will never heat anything. Within the first 5 minutes the cheaply made plastic turning rod broke off and the metal ended up in the popcorn that barely even popped 1/2 way with kernals flying over the place - do yourself a favor get a hot-air popper for $20 and youll do yourself a favor.

I read all the reviews before buying, so I knew people were divided in their opinions. My family is a big fan of this popper. We have it sitting on the bar, and it nearly always has popcorn in it. We found that by giving the oil a brief time to get hot before adding the popcorn we had very few old maids. My grandchildren are thrilled to always have popcorn available at my house. This is a great appliance at a great price.

This is a cute and stylish sport bra and I was thrilled to see one with larger cup sizes available with pretty colors and style.
