You will not be disappointed in the Vornado Air Circulator. The third setting is almost too cool for me. Thats just how good it is. With most all fans and circulators, the noise level increases as the speed increases, but thats a very minor issue compared to the quality of the product.

In August I drove up to New England for a course and packed the fan in the car because in the evenings the temperature was in the 80s indoors. The first night in a b&b I put the fan on top of a table in front of the window air-con unit and it worked really well at taking the cool air and blowing it throughout the room. The next few nights in a college dorm room with no air-con, I put the fan on a shelf at the foot of my bed and adjusted it so air was blowing horizontally from the foot of the bed up and over me, I found the fan noise acceptable on low for quiet operation overnight. The compact 530 fan could be improved by adding a feature to auto-rotate from side to side but as it is now I appreciated its compact size, the range of manual vertical adjustment, its quietness on the lowest speed setting, and how on higher (louder) speeds it is powerful enough to act as a room air circulator on its own.

I bought three of these units in the spring of 2011, all 3 have performed flawlessly over the past year. Overall the units are very quiet (except on high mode, but then again no fan is quiet when maxed out) and the medium/low setting are barely noticeable and much better than the competition. If the quality product design wasnt good enough, I recently accidentally knocked over one of these fans (it fell 6 feet, something I expect anything made of plastic to not survive unharmed) and broke one of the fan blades. Customer service was very helpful and despite my admission that it broke due to my fault, Vornado is sending me a replacement fan blade assembly free of charge. This is the type of quality and service that is lacking in many products these days and I highly recommend this fan. Plus it is the easiest fan to clean I have ever owned, overall a very well designed product.

I have several Vornado fans. I use a small one in my living room, adjacent to the floor register in my living room, and I use one near the wall register in my bedroom. Both fans help circulate the cold air from my central air system and make the rooms very comfortable even in the hottest weather. In the winter I use a Vornado combination fan/heater in my kitchen and it does a nice job in warming this hard to heat area. I like the Vornado products as they are well made, quiet, and I have bought Vornado fans for family members as gifts. Vornados customer service is top notch. I broke a shroud on one of my fans and a couple of the fins were cracked. I called customer service and they promptly shipped me a replacement part, without charge! The great products, and the great service, make me a repeat customer!

I have two other fans...NEITHER of which even when combined has 1/100 the effectiveness of this small but powerful fan. I just bought this a few days ago and LOVE IT!!! It moves the air, cools the room AND me better on low than my other fans do on high! It does exactly what the description says it does. However, unless you experience it for yourself...you cant possibly understand how wonderful it is have such a fan. My apartment is hot all the time and the other fans werent effective unless they were on high which meant a constant roaring noise over which I could not hear the TV or have a phone conversation. I can position my new Vornado, turn it on low, easily hear over it and be very very comfortably cool. Thanks to Vornado...my life got better. I plan on checking out their other products.

After 2 years of running 24/7, my Vornado started making a whining noise. Called customer service and the problem was quickly resolved with a replacement. Excellent customer service. With the purchase of my Vornado, I was able to go from 3 fans running in my home down to the one fan. It works great. Initially, I was a bit skeptical about spending that much on a single fan, but overall, it was the right choice. In the 2 years that I had it, I would have easily gone through 5-6 of the other brands. The energy savings alone of not having to run 3 fans continually paid for my Vornado. This is the only fan for me from here on out. I would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone. GREAT WORK VORNADO!!!

This is coming from a guy who takes a half an hour trying to pick out a movie at the store. What sets Vornado apart is the fact that it jumps far ahead of any other fan out there. It creates the perfect amount of breeze, is quiet, and itâ€™s extremely accessible. I had mine in a dorm for over three years now and it has fallen numerous times on concrete and dangled from the cord no-less. Still in fully operable condition and almost no dust buildup either!!! Only complaint for mine is that it only has two settings. One quiet summer breeze and one ARCTIC SUPER BLAST 9000! So if you have a choice, go with the Rolex/Bentley/Versace of fans. Purchased January 2015I purchased these boots based on reviews of other products the company makes, since this boot was not reviewed by anyone. I must say, I made a great decision. They broke in easily and never rubbed any part of my foot raw or to a blister. The toe area is very roomy. They are a 6 category boot, but comparing them to some others that I have had, they are a high 6, which still sits at a good spot on my ankle/leg. The tongue has ample cushioning on the upper, and has stayed centered on my leg (other boots I have had the tongue tends to wander to the side).So far my only complaint has been where the laces transition from the foot to the ankle staying tighter while the toe and upper have been a little loose, and trying to balance that portion out.

Update July 2015:Six months is usually the test on whether a pair of boots will cut it or need to be tossed. I am glad to say that these boots have made the cut. The leather itself has held up well, even with being in muddy conditions. No cracking or deep creases. There is no signs of separation in any of the seams or soles. They have not stretched out like other boots, so they still fit really nicely. I am still on the first set of laces which is a plus. I have to do a lot of walking on my current job, averaging between 8-10 miles a day. My feet are never sore at the end of the day, while my coworkers complain about their dogs barking. I highly recommend these boots if you are looking for a quality, comfortable pair.

My Husband and I got a set of these rings for our 20th anniversary, while we still loved our original wedding rings, they no longer fit and re-sizing them wasnt an option. Looking around for matching rings that fit our style, but werent too expensive we settled on 2 different sets. In the end, since it was our 20th wedding anniversary we decided to get both of them since the prices were so good. We wear these rings for our every day ring, keeping the black & gold rings in the same design for our special occasion rings. The dragon design shows up more on the black / gold set but it looks great on both of them. These look a bit more mainstream at first glance, standard Celtic knotwork - not everyone will know youre wearing dragons. A few notes - go to a JC Penny store to get sized for these rings and make sure they know youre getting a wide band ring and need to be sized with the thicker sizing ring set. We forgot and my husbands ring ended up being too small the first time around so we had to exchange it. Secondly, these rings cant be engraved by just anybody - they require laser engraving and some stores wont do that if you bought the ring elsewhere. We still plan to get ours engraved eventually to match our original rings but havent been able to do so yet. Last, the pictures dont really show it but there is a layer of clear resin over the dragon design which makes the ring surface flat. It looks good, but for durability reasons we take ours off before showers, swimming, washing dishes etc. Then again we always took our rings off before stuff like that anyway. All in all were very happy with our rings and everyone who has seen them loves them.
We wanted a ring that wasnt the ordinary gold or silver band so this silver with gold inlay was perfect.
The ring is very thick and sturdy. Elegant with varied detail.

I am thoroughly disappointed in this ring. The two rings we received did not look like the stock photo. Also the rings are not true to size. The ring looks better in person , picture doesnt do it justice,

My husband bought this ring as a replacement when his original wedding band was lost. He loves it! It looks great on your finger and is so easy care because of the stainless steel. You will NOT be disappointed by this ring. Buy it!
Solid and gorgeous wedding band. Classy, not tacky, with its intricate carvings.

The quality and workmanship is great and well worth the price. The fit is perfect.

I purchased this machine approximately one month ago and am extremely happy with the ease-of-use and functionality drying time takes longer than the conventual machine but all in all this is an exceptional machine

Unable to use Perm Press without destroying the perm press. Nylon clothing and mixed polyster/cotton come out needing to be pressed. Cant use cotton only material without ruining them.Good for Sheets, Towels and underwear where appearance is not a major factor.

I was skeptical at first, how can one machine effectively wash and dry my clothes and do it well? I wasnt used to a combo machine and I didnt think it would ever win me over, but it has. I am able to do laundry during the day when I am not home by using the delay feature. I put a load in the machine in the morning, delay it until the afternoon, press start, and its ready to fold just after I walk in the door that evening. When you remove the need to switch laundry from the washer to the dryer you make laundry more convenient.I recommend reading the manual and watching the videos because some things are not intuitive, like just washing or just drying, but once you figure them out its easy. I would absolutely recommend this machine to others. The only down side I see is that even when I remove items as soon as its done, some are still rather wrinkled. On the whole I think its a fine trade off to be able to set it and forget it.

From the day I bought this machine I have been disappointed and should have returned it but I thought it was just a learning curve on my part. Not true. It shakes the entire house when it is spinning. So much so that once it shook the water lines off and flooded my laundry room. It doesnt do a very good job of drying anything! I have drying racks in my laundry room. Weve had it repaired shortly after purchasing for a wire ring issue. Hoping to get some type of repair to alleviate the terrible vibration issue. The only plus is it looks nice and if you have a small space, as I do, it fits.

We opted for this unit instead of a stacked washer/dryer so that we could gain the extra closet space that the previous W/D set took up. Giving up the dryer and gaining that usable space is significant when living in a small condo. Itll be nice to install some shelving and additional storage.The setup took less than 20 minutes. I followed the instructions, but it is simple enough that all you need to do is attach the water hoses, clip the drain hose in place, plug in the power cord and start washing.The laundry capacity is decent, but probably less than what I was previously able to do. A full wash & dry cycle can easily take ~1 - 1.5 hrs. So, youll just have to adjust your schedule to washing smaller loads more frequently. Well be using the delayed start feature so a load is done during the day and then we can do another one or two at night.

I bought this item in November since I was upgrading all of my appliances. This unit is made for apartments, coops and condos. It fits perfectly in my unit. I got it in stainless steel and it is so compact and does a full load of laundry so quickly. So economical and my monthly bills have gone down.

Ive owned this for about 2 years. Ive had to disassemble it 3 times to clean lint out of the inner drying mechanism. It passes so much lint through the drain that it backed up our entire sewer line within a year. Weve tried lint filters, but it fills them completely and floods the house within 5-10 cycles. Would not install this in a multi-unit building because it causes such backup issues, and hard to justify the compact unit when you need a laundry sink to drain into to prevent all the overflows.
Ive now had this for 8 months and I could not be happier.

I liked how easy it is to use. The water tank does fill up quickly, but to me it gave me a sense of accomplishments seeing the dirty water go down the drain. I think if the tank was any bigger it would be to heavy so I am ok with the size of it. All parts are easy to clean, except the big plastic piece in front. Although it includes a handy tool to clean that area, I think it should lift up for easier cleaning. Oh the only other thing I found to be a small problem was how the attachment hose wraps around. I kept knocking it off as I was cleaning my carpet. I have not used any of the attachments yet. But know they will come in handy when I do.

I have owned this Hoover model for three years, two full carpet cleanings each year plus spot or heavily used areas more often. Two dogs, two cats. The gray water that comes out of the machine is testament to cleaning occurring. Has paid for itself by not renting a grocery/hardware store machine 6 times.

Ive used my steam vac for three years. This week, while cleaning carpets the water supply failed. I phoned repair shops and was told that water pump failure was a common occurrence. But due to slow shipping of parts, costly parts and effort to repair the part, it was not worth while to repair the unit. They recommended purchase of a new vac and did not recommend purchasing another Hoover product.

This was a shock to me because I liked the vac. Although it was plastic in construction Id gotten many years of clean carpets with it. It angers me to suspect that Hoover has planned obsolescence into the product. Hoover seems to assume that I have unlimited resources and enjoy filling landfills with large purchase items.

If the vac were better engineered and built, I would gladly have it repaired (at reasonable cost) and continue to use it for many more years. Also consider that this is also a product that is used rarely by the average consumer. The life cycle of this vac is abysmal.

This machine isnt built like the older model Hoover Carpet Cleansers.  This machine has leaked when you use the hand brush cleaner so I brought it to a service center.  I checked it when I picked it up but didnt need to use it and it leaked very little like a drop.  Went to use it when we returned from being away for the winter which by then was out of warranty and it leaked all over the place and didnt matter what you tried to do to the tube which delivers the cleaning detergent leaks where it fits in. Poor design now so cant use it unless we take our furniture outside to clean them.  I am looking for a different companies cleaner because you cant move steps etc outside and you loose so much of your cleaner.  Hoover said it is out of warranty and wont do anything.  We have only used it maybe 3 or 4 times the machine which did carpet which is no problem when we did that. We dont use one that often when you dont have animals or children and you travel so you dont need one very often.

We bought this carpet cleaner in 2013, after much research. We have pets, and our house was fairly new, so we wanted to be able to keep things clean and smelling fresh. Our Hoover SteamVac Carpet Cleaner has been a godsend for that purpose. We dont think we could ever manage without it!!

After years of hauling home the store rentals and cleaning carpet for 12 hours to get it done in a day before being charged extra, I bought this machine. The assembly was done in less than half an hour, which was mostly spent reading the manual first. As the little woman of the house, I was quite please with myself when I was finished. I was pleasantly surprised when I used it the first time, at its ease of operation. The powerful suction and heating element leaves the carpet almost dry when finished. The hose attachment is wonderful for cleaning the stairs. I like being able to clean a few rooms at a time, rather than having to finish in a single day. Its not heavy, or complicated to operate. After cleaning the tanks, I usually leave them to dry in the bathtub and then reassemble the unit. Ive owned this machine for over a year, and have used it many times. Each time it has worked beautifully, without any problems. Its a wonderful machine, and my personal thanks to the designer at Hoover.

This is my 4th Hoover steam cleaner.  My first was way back and had no brushes.  My 2nd I still use at our lake home.  The 3rd was still working, but was used a lot and we just decided to go for a new one with more features.

This machine is amazing!  It got spots out I didnt even realize were there.  I was confused as to what the difference was with this and the Pet Complete so I called Hoover and asked.  I had seen many asking this question on other sites.  Basically, the difference is in the hand tool, which is designed for cleaning furniture and stairs with lots of pet hair.  As I live in a condo with no stairs and leather couches, I went with this one.  I thank Hoover for clarifying the differences.  My only issue is the power surge button.  It is kind if hard to hold down, but played with it and found a way that is not too difficult.
You cant go wrong with either one.  It is well made and by far the best one I have owned.  Keep up with the quality work and improvements.  Thanks Hoover!!

I bought my Hoover carpet cleaner in March 2012. I worked great at first. In the last 4 months, everytime I clean my carpet it makes streaks in my carpet. I cleans but, I can see the streaks, like brush marks, in my carpet once it dries. It looks abosolutely terrible after my carpet dries. I tried cleaning the brush but, still streaks. I thought maybe my agitator could be clogged. So I am purchasing a new one today. I hope this alleviates the problem. But, if not, I will purchase a new machine.
This product is light weight and easy to use on hardwood floors and carpet
I bought this 5 months ago and I love it.

This is extremely lightweight, not over complicated, and it uses a bag!! The belt change is quick and easy, the wind-flow channels by the rollerbrush disassemble for cleaning.The vac has multiple height adjustments which is great for us because we have higher pile frieze carpeting and dogs. Being able to set the vac to a higher setting lifts the carpet pile up instead of it folding over like vacuums that do not have a height adjuster. Ive found that having the adjuster removes more fur because it allows more airflow around the rollerbrush instead of the suction pulling the vac head down and burying it into the carpet like with non-adjustable vacuums.

I have only one disappointment: after 5 months my roller brush or motor is making moaning sounds when it powers down. I just put a new belt on it a few weeks back then I started smelling metal a metal-on-metal odor. Now Im getting a moaning. I cannot tell if its a roller brush or a motor. Is this a warranty issue?

It was the first thing I bought when I moved into an apt with carpet. I have used it forever 9 years. Best suction ever. I wish the hose was longer, but I will tell yah why I am writing now, I just got wood floors and we all know how uprights are with them. So instead of buying yet another vacuum. I have 4( the hoover,eureka baggless upright, dirt devil hand held, and bissel stick). For the hoover ,which is the simplest to take apart and clean,..2 screws,I took the brush & belt off, bought a simple floor brush from [@ for a kenmore tag along. put it on the end, it fit perfect. I now have a Pull along upright to do my hard wood floors. No other vacuum has the suction with a bag. Frankly the baggless are messy cause you have to clean them after use or they lose suction and get gummed up. Yah, Bells and whistles are nice, but bottom line, if it doesnt suck, it may be the one using it. Love it no matter how I use it, you have to take care of it and it will take care of you.

nice vacuum cleaner, however, was surprised to find I need to buy filters. I wanted a simple vacuum with just bags to buy. Also found the vacuum to be still too heavy to go up and down stairs. But, overall, its a good machine and pretty simple to vacuum with since it seems to move forward almost by itself.

This is my second one of these. I clean a large office building and have tried several vacuums. The Sears lost its wheels after a few short months, the Electrolux same thing. Then they bought the Widepath and it has endured the longest, by far, for a fraction of the price of the others. I change the brushes and belts occasionally and just keeps doing its job and doing very well.

This is my second tempo widepath. It is a great upright for small apartments. The onboard tools are well placed and more than adequate. The cord is just right for a one bedroom. I did a little experiment and discovered that absolutely NO dust comes out of the vents while vacuuming. The carpet is clean, the filters are washable, and the dirt and dust accumulating on the inside of the Hoover can be easily wiped and does not blow into the air. This is a very good vacuum for the price. I am disabled and vacuum the carpet twice a day due to my condition, as well as my furniture and bed, and the machine just lasts and lasts.

Ive gone through many vacuums over the years. No matter how expensive, how many attachments, or how great the promises on the box are, they inevitably fall apart, lose suction, and become useless. Ive owned this vacuum for about 3 years and use it every other day on about 1,000 square feet of carpet. Its utilitarian, a bit on the loud side, and not the most modern looking vacuum out there, but its solid design, hardy components, and straightforward usage is a delight in a world filled with fussy gadgets with short lifespans. I did a lot of research before buying this vacuum, and other reviewers unanimously agree: This is the *best* value for a household vacuum out there. I anticipate I will have this vacuum for years to come, replacing parts from Hoover as necessary. I would recommend buying the cloth Hoover brand Y type bags. I bought a pack of generic brand Y bags recently, and they are much smaller and thinner. They fill up faster and do not filter dust as well. With my usage, I fill up the Hoover brand bags about every 3 months.

Ive had this van for 3 yrs.  Had to buy it because my Hoover Sprit vac (Id had for 10 yrs.!!) had bristles worn down to pointy nubs (& was tearing up the carpet) & would no longer stay upright (the lever broke).  I wanted another Spirit, but Hoover doesnt make it anymore.  I took the Spirit to work & made it the vac @ work, cuz those carpets are the indoor/outdoor type, so the worn-to-a-point bristles dont matter, nor does the fact that it flops around.  I mention this because the Spirit still works and so Im able to compare it to the Tempo which I bought to replace it.  The noise the Tempo makes is 3 TIMES LOUDER than the old Sprit & I HATE that.  The Tempo is a decent vac & actually has more suction than the Spirit did, but the noise!  I live in an apt. so every time I vacuum I bug the neighbors.  I miss my Spirit. Hoover needs to make the Tempo quieter.  Or remake the Spirit.  I LOVED that vac.
I returned it on Monday and bought it on Friday. It completely stopped working and spit all the dirt and carpet cleaner it had picked up back on to the floor.
Awesome vaccum for half the price as other name brands. Cant believe what it picked up that my old vaccum left behind.
I bought this on Brads Deal abs love it. It picks up dirt you dont see going over an area just once. Great attachments to clean furniture. Love it

I could not believe how much dog hair this machine picked up from my rugs, and I had just had my cleaning lady here. It was very easy to assemble the handle and accessories. It was a little heavy for me (Im 65), but I would definitely recommend this vacumn. It works great and I bought it when Hoover had 50% so only paid about $50 for it. What a bargain! Definitely thinking about ordering one for my mom too.
This product is economical and works well. It provides a deep clean for carpets.

Id owned my old (non Hoover) upright vacuum for probably 20+ years and felt it was time for an upgrade - esp since I found this great price of less than $60 for the Hoover - WindTunnel 2. I was so impressed with the Hoover WindTunnel. The first time I used it, I was amazed at all the dirt, dust and such that it removed from my 40+ year old carpet. The carpet pile that had been flat and lifeless now stood up and was soft to the touch again. It was almost like having new carpet!!! Im amazed!

Putting item together was a snap. Vacuums well. The vacuum is loud, perhaps others are as well. I wear hearing protection while using. I really like not having to buy vacuum bags. Emptying the dust bin is simple, but you need to be careful or else some dust will escape.
Cleans very well. Good quality. Great price! Especially like the way all tools ride along on machine. Love the powered hand tool to clean the furniture. Does a great job!

We recently purchased this vacuum because we had our hardwood floors refinished and were looking for a canister vacuum with a non-powered brushed head. This was about the only vacuum we could find to fit the bill that wasnt ridiculously priced. I read the reviews first, and was a little hesitant because of some of the one-star reviews, but figured we would take a chance. After trying on our wood floors and tiled kitchen floors, I decided to try it on the carpeting upstairs. I was amazed by the amount of dirt and hair this vacuum picked up and shocked by what our old vacuum left behind.I kind of agree that the cord could be a few feet longer, but have had no problems dumping the dirt cup or the unit shutting down (well wait and see about that issue). The vacuum is light and easy to manipulate. The multitool takes a bit getting used to, but since we lost a couple of attachments to our old vacuum, I guess having a larger multitool might be better. Not a bad value for the money.

This is my 4th Hoover vacuum and being satisfied with other hoover models, I was excited to get this vacuum to use on my downstairs hardwood floors. At first, it was a great vacuum with amazing suction however, the plastic dirt cup on then inside canister broke (poor design flaw- when trying to dump out the dirt after use, the lid would come unlocked and fall into trash can- same thing happened with dirt cup. When I carefully tried to put the dirt cup back in place it broke- very cheap little plastic locking design). Also the way you dump out the dirt causes the dirt to fly everywhere and cause a mess! Hoover was very good to us and replaced the broken part because it was under warranty. Shortly after they replaced it, the power nozzle kept coming detached from the extended shaft. My husband has had to fix it repeatedly and it is now duct taped onto the vacuum. Thirdly, the vacuum started making a VERY LOUD high pitched squealing sound when I vacuum. I am at a loss as to what to do. I dump out the canister after use, I shake the dust out of the filters and I pull any hair or dirt that catches inside. I am a pet free home, and use it for daily sweeping. I am sad this vacuum has not held up well. It also has a very short power cord which limits how much area you can reach and requires me to constantly stop vacuuming to replug it into another outlet. I have owned this vacuum only 2.5 years. I am going to toss it out and buy something else. I am not sure if I will buy another hoover if this is the quality they are now making.

I bought this vacuum 6 weeks ago, even though some of the reviews were not the best because of running hot.  I found it hard to believe that Hoover would continue to release a product with this type of dangerous problem.

I was very upset when my vacuum overheated to the point the base was so hot it couldnt be touched!  It took almost an hour to cool off and reset. This is very poor engineering and worse, that Hoover is still selling a machine knowing about the problem.

When I contacted customer service, I was told I had to take this to a local repair shop.  The response is unacceptable - I would have expected them to send a replacement right away since I just purchased only 6 weeks ago.   This is the way other, customer oriented companies work - but with Hoover, Im told the burden is on me to physically take the vacuum in for repair!!
Unless Hoover has a better quality vacuum, that doesnt overheat, this is going in the trash & I will be buying a different brand!

This is the worse vacuum I have bought! The suction doesnt last through I session and our house is 1100sqft! I have to completely take it apart to clean it at least three times within 15 mins! The inner tube gets clogged and you lose suction!

Weve had this vacuum for two years dont see any reason why we would look to replace it in the near future. Its reasonably light, moves around easy enough, and has great suction. Its not super quiet, and it does let off a bit of heat, but it does a really great job picking up alot of dust and dirt. I do wish the wind up cord was a bit longer (6 feet or so), and that the hose was a few feet longer for stairs.

Its a great vacuum, and I think alot of the negative reviews are from people with higher expectations regarding maintenance. Nothing is maintenance free, and certainly not a vacuum at this price range. The filters need to be washed on a regular basis, and after alot of heavy usage, it is best to replace the filters. We replaced them after two years of use, and its like brand new again with suction. Dont let those negative ratings worry you, as long as you are willing to spend 5 to 10 minutes the odd time to make sure its running tip top. Ill be buying a few extra filters now just incase they change the style.

I owned my last canister vacuum for 10 years before I began to see signs of wear... not the case with this one. In a little over a year the hose began to separate from the handle. Once it started to go suction was lost.

Ive had this vac for over a year and still love it. However, I can see why some people have run into issues because without regular cleaning it will start to run hot. For the first few months I thought was the best thing ever, then it started to lose suction. However, I found that the top main filter was clogged and needed a wash, which I did and everything was back to normal. To keep this machine running like new, all you have to do is empty both the dirt catcher AND the red baffle inside it after EVERY session. It takes two seconds and the parts are designed to be removed easily to allow this. Every couple months, remove and rinse the filter which you can do under a warm tap. I came to Hoover.com to find a replacement HEPA filter, which is a second filter in the wheel assembly, which was clogged with very fine dust. As I say, mines over a year old and I just replaced it for the first time... Now its running like the day I bought it. Recommended.

We have tried two separate vacuums. The first randomly quit working after three months. There was no obvious cause for this on inspection. The store we bought it from allowed us to do an exchange. This second vacuum has also quit within the month. I suspected it was maybe a thermal fuse issue caused by overheating, but a) Im careful to clean all areas of the vacuum to avoid overheating and b) it has never reset and the vacuum wont turn on. When it works, it is a great vacuum with awesome suction. It is light and easy to use, especially on stairs. We can use it on our carpet, hardwood, and tile. I just cant keep one going for more than three months.

I recently purchased a Hoover vacuum, the Wind Tunnel Air Steerable upright. I thought I would try one after using Oreck and Eureka brands. It is light, has so much power, so easy to use and empty. I never thought my carpets were that dirty, considering my kids are grown and gone, and I have 2 non-shedding dogs! Wow! I couldnt believe the stuff it picked up the first time I used it! I love it! Thanks, Hoover for making a quality product for a reasonable price!

At first this thing worked great I was very pleased. After about 6 months its making a lot of noise doesnt seem to clean the floors like it used to when looking on this site for some parts theyre out of stock and seem to be high priced. At almost $200 its not a super high priced vacuum but I dont feel like I should be replacing things so soon. My last vacuum was a Hoover lasted me 10 years and was still working pretty good when I replaced it. At this point I need to decide if I want to spend 50-60 bucks to get it up and running good or just toss it and buy a new one.

I bought this vacuum 7 months ago from bed bath and beyond. It was working great until a few months ago it started making noise. We took it apart and noticed the brush roller end was broken. Ive been waiting over a month for a new brush roller to become in stock but no luck. Now I have a new vacuum that I cannot use. I only have two rooms to vacuum. Its not like it had a hard 6 month life. Do I buy a new vacuum? Or keep waiting for Hoover to get this roller brush part in?

Bought this vacuum for its features. Easy to use, light weight, turn feature makes vacuuming easy. Was enjoying this machine until the power brush stoped working. It has an on and off button for the power brush and and an overload feature also for the power brush. No matter what I tried, pushing the on off button or waiting for the overlod feature to kick in, the brush would not work. Took off the baseplate to check the belt and found the belt OK. Could not turn the motor shaft by hand, seems to be frozen in place?
Took the machine to a Hoover repair center and I am now without a vacuum for 3 to 4 weeks. Gentleman at the repair facility said maybe less time but count on 3 to 4.
Had a previous Hoover machine for 14 years and had no problems. Gave in to my grand daughter and it is till working. We will see about this new machine when I get it back.
Very disappointed.

At first it did a great job. Good suction. Then the 2nd battery went totally dead. The motor head just died and that is key to the suction. For light weight jobs and needs to be cleaned often. Not worth the money.

This vacuum is certainly picking up dust and debris compared to my old vacuum cleaner. It is much easier to clean and dump the dirt. I love the swivel feature as it makes it easier to get around furniture. Lightweight - easy to carry upstairs.
I purchased a month ago and so far am happy with it although is heavier than i had expected

Works well on hard wood and very short carpet, but you cannot push it at all over longer carpeting and there is no adjustment for that. Really disappointed to have spent the money on this vacuum and now need a second one.

I just bought this product. Wow the suction was outstanding. This is actually my first time buying a hoover. My only complaint is the interlocking tube. Is a little short and wish it was metal. Thats the only reason why I did not give it 5 stars.

Our old Hoover wasnt working well so we got this new one recommended by Consumer Report. The WindTunnel Max cleaned carpet, carpeted stairs, accent rugs, upholstery and general dusting with excellent results. The nap was lifted and we were greatly pleased with the total results. We recommend this to all.

i only have the sweeper a few weeks but I am happy with performance so far,,i like the attachement and long hose,you can switc from carpet to hard wood by a foot switch, that switch is plastic hope it holds up
Does a good job on all my different types of carpet.

Purchased this model via another online retailer because it was a little cheaper - thought Hoover would be a quality product however this machine does not equal the quality of a comparable 15 yr. old Eureka bagged upright. Had three weeks before it had to be repaired under warranty at authorized repair shop - no vacuum for 2 weeks - when it was returned for the repair - bearings in beater bar were shot - since being repaired beater bar continues to rotate after being turned off and cannot use shut off for beater bar for bare floor use.

My husband, bless his heart, bought me a Dyson because he thought it was the best and it was just awful! I tried to get used to it for weeks but finally told him I want another Hoover Bagged Upright! The HEPA filters are the best and no dog hair floating everywhere when I empty the unit with the bag. Yay!

We have owned many hover products and have always recommended Hoover. Before purchasing any appliance or tool, we also look at the reviews from Consumer Reports. I dont know how this model got the reviews it did. After two months of use, (approx 30 uses) the internal parts started to break. It would not adjust from carpet to wood/smooth surfaces nor would it adjust the suction power on the different carpets. We purchased this vacuum to be able to clean multiple surfaces by using one tool instead of many. To empty the bag is no easy task, but I would forgive that feature if it performed as it did when first purchased.True. the attachments are great and the hose length to clean the staircases is amazing, but not worth the other hassle.I took the vacuum to the recommended dealer in my city who wanted as much to fix it as it was to purchase it.
I bought it to replace a Eureka and Im glad I did. Its doing a great job

I had a lighter weight Hoover Wind Tunnel, and got a promo to buy this model at a really GREAT price so decided to go for it. Right out of the box, it was immediatly apparent that this was a heavier duty unit. Easy to assemble, lots of nice bells and whistles- really like the fold down handle and the retractable cord - and its about 8 ft longer than my previous Hoover which is really helpful - not having to run around changing from power outlet to power outlet as you work.. Now heres the reason you buy a vacuum - suction power. Decided to give my living area a once over with the old Hoover (which I thought was just great and did a good job) and then follow it up with the new one - this one - and was honestly AMAZED at how much more dog hair and dirt this vacuum pulled out of the carpets - right after vacuuming with my old Hoover vacuum. That said - it is pretty heavy, and takes more effort to use it - but - totally worth it for the results. Highly recommend!

We purchased this model on special to replace a 7 year old Hoover that we loved, but is starting to fall apart. We have a dog, 3 cats, 3 kids and various other creatures, hence the PetPlus model choice. My wife decided to try out the vacuum on a wool rug we had in our living room. The prior vacuum cleaned pretty well. This one pulled out a solid 2 containers worth of material (various animal hair, broken wool fibers, dust, dirt, etc). She was very impressed. The only complaint is with the wand attachment. We have wood/tile floors in the majority of our house, so use the wand attachment all the time. We found the wand attachment a little short and will bother your back over time. She also said it was short a couple of attachments compared to our old vacuum. Not missing, just never included as part of the package. We would buy again, but these last two items diminish the overall view of the vaccum.
Love this vacuum. It took literally 5 minutes to assemble and once I started to use it, my carpets never looked cleaner. Easy to empty. The pet hair tools work better than expected.
Hello, My name is Gail and I have used Hover products for 60 years. As a young wife and mother, I knew that a Hover vacuum would pick up all of the different dusts in my home.
Today the Hover has improved to the point that a 72 year old lady (me) knows that when I vacuum my rugs, sofa, stairs, hardwood floors all of the pet hair will be removed.

I have bought my Grandchildren their school cloths from Pennys fro the past several years. From the jeans and shirts, to the underwear and socks all stand the washing machine and last beyond the school year.
I want to thank Hover for caring about their customers. Gail Marie
